verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי מוֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיִּשְׁאֲלוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּיהוָה לֵאמֹר מִי יַעֲלֶה־לָּנוּ אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי בַּתְּחִלָּה לְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ׃
verses.english: Now it was after the death of Yehoshua trad. English “Joshua.” that the Children of Israel inquired of YHWH, saying:Who among us will go up first against the Canaanites to wage battle against them?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה יְהוּדָה יַעֲלֶה הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי אֶת־הָאָרֶץ בְּיָדוֹ׃
verses.english: YHWH said:Yehuda The Hebrew name for the largest and politically most significant Israelite tribe, from which the favored dynasty of David sprang. Where it refers to the Southern Kingdom in Samuel and Kings, I use “Judah” to distinguish it from the single tribe. will go up;here, I have given the land into his hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְשִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו עֲלֵה אִתִּי בְגוֹרָלִי וְנִלָּחֲמָה בַּכְּנַעֲנִי וְהָלַכְתִּי גַם־אֲנִי אִתְּךָ בְּגוֹרָלֶךָ וַיֵּלֶךְ אִתּוֹ שִׁמְעוֹן׃
verses.english: Yehuda said to Shim’on trad. English “Simeon.” his brother-tribe:Go up with me into my allotted-territory, and let us wage battle against the Canaanites,and I will go with you as well into your allotted-territory.So Shim’on went with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל יְהוּדָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי בְּיָדָם וַיַּכּוּם בְּבֶזֶק עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ׃
verses.english: Yehuda went up,and YHWH gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand,so that they struck them down in Bezek,ten thousand) as a military division, so the number would be smaller in that case. men.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצְאוּ אֶת־אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק בְּבֶזֶק וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בּוֹ וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְאֶת־הַפְּרִזִּי׃
verses.english: They found Adoni-Vezek in Bezek either a site northeast of Shekhem or one between that city and Jerusalem., and waged battle against him,and they struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנָס אֲדֹנִי בֶזֶק וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אֹתוֹ וַיְקַצְּצוּ אֶת־בְּהֹנוֹת יָדָיו וְרַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: And Adoni-Vezek fled, so they pursued after him,and they seized him and chopped off the thumbs of his hands and of his feet.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲדֹנִי־בֶזֶק שִׁבְעִים מְלָכִים בְּהֹנוֹת יְדֵיהֶם וְרַגְלֵיהֶם מְקֻצָּצִים הָיוּ מְלַקְּטִים תַּחַת שֻׁלְחָנִי כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתִי כֵּן שִׁלַּם־לִי אֱלֹהִים וַיְבִיאֻהוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיָּמָת שָׁם׃
verses.english: Adoni-Vezek said:Seventy kings, the thumbs of their hands and of their feet chopped off,used to gather [crumbs] under my table;as I did, so has God paid me back!They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בְנֵי־יְהוּדָה בִּירוּשָׁלִַם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיַּכּוּהָ לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָעִיר שִׁלְּחוּ בָאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: Then the Children of Yehuda waged battle against Jerusalem:they captured it, they struck it with the mouth of the sword,and the city they sent up in fire.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר יָרְדוּ בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה לְהִלָּחֵם בַּכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב הָהָר וְהַנֶּגֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה׃
verses.english: Afterward, the Children of Yehuda went down to wage battle against the Canaanites,those settled in the highlands, the Negev, and the lowlands the low foothills that rise out of the coastal plain toward the central highlands..

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּחֶבְרוֹן וְשֵׁם־חֶבְרוֹן לְפָנִים קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־שֵׁשַׁי וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן וְאֶת־תַּלְמָי׃
verses.english: And Yehuda went against the Canaanites, the ones settled in Hevron trad. English “Hebron.” ,—now the name of Hevron in former times was Kiryat-Arba—and he struck Sheishai and Ahiman and Talmai. means “gigantic.”

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ מִשָּׁם אֶל־יוֹשְׁבֵי דְּבִיר וְשֵׁם־דְּבִיר לְפָנִים קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר׃
verses.english: He went from there against those settled in Devir—now the name of Devir in former times was Kiryat-Sefer.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר כָּלֵב אֲשֶׁר־יַכֶּה אֶת־קִרְיַת־סֵפֶר וּלְכָדָהּ וְנָתַתִּי לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתִּי לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: Now Calev trad. English “Caleb.” He seems to appear out of nowhere, but this section is apparently an established tradition (see Josh. 15:13–19). said:Whoever strikes Kiryat-Sefer and captures it,I will give him Akhsa trad. English “Achsah.” See the version of this little story that appears in Josh. 15:16ff. my daughter as a wife!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ עָתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־עַכְסָה בִתּוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: Otniel trad. English “Othniel,” possibly meaning “God Is My Strength” or “God Is My Protection.” son of Kenaz captured it,a brother of Calev younger than he,and he gave him Akhsa his daughter as a wife.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאָהּ וַתְּסִיתֵהוּ לִשְׁאוֹל מֵאֵת־אָבִיהָ הַשָּׂדֶה וַתִּצְנַח מֵעַל הַחֲמוֹר וַיֹּאמֶר־לָהּ כָּלֵב מַה־לָּךְ׃
verses.english: Now it was, when she came,that she induced him to request fielded-property from her father.She alighted from on the donkey,and Calev said to her:What [ails] you?

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ הָבָה־לִּי בְרָכָה כִּי אֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב נְתַתָּנִי וְנָתַתָּה לִי גֻּלֹּת מָיִם וַיִּתֶּן־לָהּ כָּלֵב אֵת גֻּלֹּת עִלִּית וְאֵת גֻּלֹּת תַּחְתִּית׃
verses.english: She said to him:Get me a blessing-gift,for you have given me arid land). JPS understands the expression as referring to Akhsa herself, namely, a woman without a dowry.—you should give me pools of water!So Calev gave her the Upper Pools and the Lower Pools.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי קֵינִי חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה עָלוּ מֵעִיר הַתְּמָרִים אֶת־בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה מִדְבַּר יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר בְּנֶגֶב עֲרָד וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיֵּשֶׁב אֶת־הָעָם׃
verses.english: Now the Children of the Kenite, Moshe’s father-in-law, went up from the Town of Date-Palms, along with the Children of Yehuda,into the Wilderness of Yehuda that is south of Arad;they went and settled with the people.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְהוּדָה אֶת־שִׁמְעוֹן אָחִיו וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי יוֹשֵׁב צְפַת וַיַּחֲרִימוּ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שֵׁם־הָעִיר חָרְמָה׃
verses.english: And Yehuda went with Shim’on his brother;they struck the Canaanites settled in Tzefat. A town in the Negev region, not the later famous hill town (modern Safed) in the Galilee. , and devoted-it-to-destruction as in English “harem,” something or someone set apart. Here it reflects a war concept that the spoils belong to God, not to the conquerors.,so they called the name of the town Horma/Destruction.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד יְהוּדָה אֶת־עַזָּה וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־אַשְׁקְלוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ וְאֶת־עֶקְרוֹן וְאֶת־גְּבוּלָהּ׃
verses.english: Then Yehuda captured Gaza) … and its territoryand Ashkelon and its territoryand Ekron and its territory.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהוָה אֶתּ־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּרֶשׁ אֶת־הָהָר כִּי לֹא לְהוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי הָעֵמֶק כִּי־רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל לָהֶם׃
verses.english: Now YHWH was with Yehuda, so that he took possession of the highlands,but he was not [able] to dispossess the settled-folk of the valley,for they had chariotry of iron.[able]: Missing in MT but present in some manuscripts. The restored text would then correspond to, for instance, Josh. 15:63, lo’ yakhelu le-horisham. the valley: Or “the plain.” iron: The period of settlement/Judges roughly marks the beginning of the Iron Age. For another textual comment on the Philistines’ possession of iron, and the Israelites’ need of it, see I Sam. 13:19.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ לְכָלֵב אֶת־חֶבְרוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר מֹשֶׁה וַיּוֹרֶשׁ מִשָּׁם אֶת־שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי הָעֲנָק׃
verses.english: And they gave Hevron to Calev, as Moshe had promised,and he dispossessed the three sons of Anak from there.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הַיְבוּסִי יֹשֵׁב יְרוּשָׁלִַם לֹא הוֹרִישׁוּ בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן וַיֵּשֶׁב הַיְבוּסִי אֶת־בְּנֵי בִנְיָמִן בִּירוּשָׁלִַם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: But the Yevusites, those settled in Jerusalem, the Children of Binyamin trad. English “Benjamin.” did not dispossess;the Yevusites are settled along with the Children of Binyamin in Jerusalem until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף גַּם־הֵם בֵּית־אֵל וַיהוָה עִמָּם׃
verses.english: Now the house of Yosef trad. English “Joseph.” went up, they too, to Bet-El trad. English “Beth-El.”,and YHWH was with them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּתִירוּ בֵית־יוֹסֵף בְּבֵית־אֵל וְשֵׁם־הָעִיר לְפָנִים לוּז׃
verses.english: The house of Yosef scouted out Bet-El—now the name of the town in former times was Luz—

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ הַשֹּׁמְרִים אִישׁ יוֹצֵא מִן־הָעִיר וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ הַרְאֵנוּ נָא אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וְעָשִׂינוּ עִמְּךָ חָסֶד׃
verses.english: and the watchmen saw a man going out of the town,so they said to him:Pray let us see the way to enter the town, and we will show you loyalty often denotes adherence to a treaty or agreement..

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְאֵם אֶת־מְבוֹא הָעִיר וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־הָעִיר לְפִי־חָרֶב וְאֶת־הָאִישׁ וְאֶת־כָּל־מִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ שִׁלֵּחוּ׃
verses.english: He let them see the way to enter the town, and they struck the city with the mouth of the sword,but the man and his entire clan they sent free.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָאִישׁ אֶרֶץ הַחִתִּים וַיִּבֶן עִיר וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמָהּ לוּז הוּא שְׁמָהּ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: The man went to the land of the Hittites and built a town;he called its name Luz—that is its name until this day.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הוֹרִישׁ מְנַשֶּׁה אֶת־בֵּית־שְׁאָן וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־תַּעְנַךְ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־ישב [יֹשְׁבֵי] דוֹר וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי יִבְלְעָם וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֶיהָ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי מְגִדּוֹ וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶיהָ וַיּוֹאֶל הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָשֶׁבֶת בָּאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת׃
verses.english: Menashe did not take possession of Bet-She’an and her daughter-towns,or of Ta’nakh and her daughter-towns,or of the settled-folk of Dor and her daughter-towns,or of the settled-folk of Yivle’am and her daughter-towns,or of the settled-folk of Megiddo and her daughter-towns;the Canaanites were determined to remain settled in this region.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־חָזַק יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי לָמַס וְהוֹרֵישׁ לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃
verses.english: And it was, when Israel became strong, that they put the Canaanites under forced-labor,but dispossess, they did not dispossess them.

verses.hebrew: וְאֶפְרַיִם לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַיּוֹשֵׁב בְּגָזֶר וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ בְּגָזֶר׃
verses.english: Now Efrayim did not dispossess the Canaanites, those settled in Gezer,and so the Canaanites remained settled in their midst, in Gezer.

verses.hebrew: זְבוּלֻן לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי קִטְרוֹן וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי נַהֲלֹל וַיֵּשֶׁב הַכְּנַעֲנִי בְּקִרְבּוֹ וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃
verses.english: Zevulun trad. English “Zebulun.” did not dispossess the settled-folk of Kitron, or the settled-folk of Nahalol,and so the Canaanites remained settled in their midst,and went into forced-labor.

verses.hebrew: אָשֵׁר לֹא הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי עַכּוֹ וְאֶת־יוֹשְׁבֵי צִידוֹן וְאֶת־אַחְלָב וְאֶת־אַכְזִיב וְאֶת־חֶלְבָּה וְאֶת־אֲפִיק וְאֶת־רְחֹב׃
verses.english: Asher did not dispossess the settled-folk of Akko, or the settled-folk of Sidon,or of Ahlav, or of Akhziv, or of Helba,or of Afik, or of Rehov.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב הָאָשֵׁרִי בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ כִּי לֹא הוֹרִישׁוֹ׃
verses.english: So the Asherites settled amid the Canaanites, the settled-folk of the land,for they did not dispossess them.

verses.hebrew: נַפְתָּלִי לֹא־הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וְאֶת־יֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־עֲנָת וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֵי בֵית־שֶׁמֶשׁ וּבֵית עֲנָת הָיוּ לָהֶם לָמַס׃
verses.english: Naftali did not dispossess the settled-folk of Bet-Shemeshor the settled-folk of Bet-Anat,so they settled amid the Canaanites, the settled-folk of the land,and the settled-folk of Bet-Shemesh and of Bet-Anat went into forced-labor for them.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְחֲצוּ הָאֱמֹרִי אֶת־בְּנֵי־דָן הָהָרָה כִּי־לֹא נְתָנוֹ לָרֶדֶת לָעֵמֶק׃
verses.english: And the Amorites pressed the Children of Dan into the highlands,indeed, they did not give them [leave] to go down into the valley.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹאֶל הָאֱמֹרִי לָשֶׁבֶת בְּהַר־חֶרֶס בְּאַיָּלוֹן וּבְשַׁעַלְבִים וַתִּכְבַּד יַד בֵּית־יוֹסֵף וַיִּהְיוּ לָמַס׃
verses.english: The Amorites persisted in remaining settled in Mount Heres, in Ayyalon and in Shaalvim,yet the hand of the House of Yosef grew heavy [against them], so that they went into forced-labor.

verses.hebrew: וּגְבוּל הָאֱמֹרִי מִמַּעֲלֵה עַקְרַבִּים מֵהַסֶּלַע וָמָעְלָה׃
verses.english: Now the territory of the Amorites was from Scorpions’ Pass, to the Crag and further.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָה מִן־הַגִּלְגָּל אֶל־הַבֹּכִים וַיֹּאמֶר אַעֲלֶה אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאָבִיא אֶתְכֶם אֶל־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם וָאֹמַר לֹא־אָפֵר בְּרִיתִי אִתְּכֶם לְעוֹלָם׃
verses.english: A messenger Even the traditional rendering “angel” does not necessarily imply a supernatural creature, as the English word itself reflects the Greek angelos, “messenger,” human or otherwise. of YHWH went up from Gilgal to Bokhimand said:I had you go up from Egypt,and I brought you to the land that I swore to your fathers;I said:I will not annul my covenant with you for the ages!

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם לֹא־תִכְרְתוּ בְרִית לְיוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיהֶם תִּתֹּצוּן וְלֹא־שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקֹלִי מַה־זֹּאת עֲשִׂיתֶם׃
verses.english: While you,you are not to cut a covenant with the settled-folk of this land—their altars you are to demolish!But you did not hearken to my voice.Now what have you done!

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אָמַרְתִּי לֹא־אֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וְהָיוּ לָכֶם לְצִדִּים וֵאלֹהֵיהֶם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃
verses.english: So I also say:I will not drive them out before you;they will be traps (“sides”) here may be short for “a whip in your sides” (Kimhi). to you,and their gods will be a snare to you!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּדַבֵּר מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה אֶת־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה אֶל־כָּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּשְׂאוּ הָעָם אֶת־קוֹלָם וַיִּבְכּוּ׃
verses.english: It was, when the messenger of YHWH had spoken these words to all the Children of Israel,that the people lifted up their voice and wept.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְאוּ שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא בֹּכִים וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־שָׁם לַיהוָה׃
verses.english: So they called the name of that place Bokhim/Weepers,and they sacrificed there to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלַּח יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אֶת־הָעָם וַיֵּלְכוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִישׁ לְנַחֲלָתוֹ לָרֶשֶׁת אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃
verses.english: Yehoshua had sent the fighting-people off,and the Children of Israel had gone off, each one to his hereditary-property, to take possession of the land.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ הָעָם אֶת־יְהוָה כֹּל יְמֵי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְכֹל יְמֵי הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱרִיכוּ יָמִים אַחֲרֵי יְהוֹשׁוּעַ אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֵת כָּל־מַעֲשֵׂה יְהוָה הַגָּדוֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: And the people had served YHWH all the days of Yehoshuaand all the days of the elders who had prolonged years after Yehoshua,who had seen every great deed of YHWH that he had done for Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ בִּן־נוּן עֶבֶד יְהוָה בֶּן־מֵאָה וָעֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: And Yehoshua son of Nun, the servant of YHWH, had died, a hundred and ten years old;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אוֹתוֹ בִּגְבוּל נַחֲלָתוֹ בְּתִמְנַת־חֶרֶס בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם מִצְּפוֹן לְהַר־גָּעַשׁ׃
verses.english: they had buried him in the territory of his hereditary-property, in Timnat-Heres in the highlands of Efrayim, north of the highlands of Gaash.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם כָּל־הַדּוֹר הַהוּא נֶאֶסְפוּ אֶל־אֲבוֹתָיו וַיָּקָם דּוֹר אַחֵר אַחֲרֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֶת־יְהוָה וְגַם אֶת־הַמַּעֲשֶׂה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now also that entire generation was gathered to its fathers,and another generation arose after them, that did not know YHWH,as well as the deed[s] that he had done for Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים׃
verses.english: And the Children of Israel did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH:they served the Baals) was the powerful thunderstorm/fertility god of the area, whose mythic exploits are preserved on clay tablets from the ancient city of Ugarit on the Syrian coast, fifteenth–thirteenth centuries B.C.E. Judges and Samuel give evidence of the strong attraction of this Canaanite god for Israelite farmers. Some of YHWH’s characteristics echo Baal’s; both, for example, are referred to in their respective literatures as “Rider on the Clouds.”,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתָם הַמּוֹצִיא אוֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים מֵאֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבוֹתֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם וַיַּכְעִסוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: they abandoned YHWH, the God of their fathers,the one who brought them out of the land of Egypt,and they walked after other gods, from among the gods of the peoples who were around them;they bowed down to themand so provoked YHWH—

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ לַבַּעַל וְלָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת׃
verses.english: they abandoned YHWHand served Baal and the Astartes goddesses usually identified with well-known divine figures such as the Babylonian Ishtar. Here the plural is probably meant to include various local goddesses..

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־שֹׁסִים וַיָּשֹׁסּוּ אוֹתָם וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד אוֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ עוֹד לַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי אוֹיְבֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: So YHWH’s anger flared up against Israel,and he gave them into the hand of pillagers, so that they pillaged them,and sold them into the hand of their enemies round about,so that they were no longer able to stand up before their enemies.

verses.hebrew: בְּכֹל אֲשֶׁר יָצְאוּ יַד־יְהוָה הָיְתָה־בָּם לְרָעָה כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר יְהוָה וְכַאֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה לָהֶם וַיֵּצֶר לָהֶם מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Whenever they went out [to war], the hand of YHWH was against them for evil,as YHWH had promised,as YHWH had sworn to them,and they were exceedingly distressed.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם יְהוָה שֹׁפְטִים וַיּוֹשִׁיעוּם מִיַּד שֹׁסֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Then YHWH raised up judge-leaders often means “to lead” or “to govern”; I have sought to retain both senses, at least this first time. See the passage in 3:10, below.;they delivered them from the hand of their plunderers.

verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֶל־שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמֵעוּ כִּי זָנוּ אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לָהֶם סָרוּ מַהֵר מִן־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלְכוּ אֲבוֹתָם לִשְׁמֹעַ מִצְוֺת־יְהוָה לֹא־עָשׂוּ כֵן׃
verses.english: But also to their judges they did not hearken:indeed, they went whoring after other godsand bowed down to them;they quickly turned aside from the way that their fathers had walked, hearkening to the commands of YHWH—they did not do thus.

verses.hebrew: וְכִי־הֵקִים יְהוָה לָהֶם שֹׁפְטִים וְהָיָה יְהוָה עִם־הַשֹּׁפֵט וְהוֹשִׁיעָם מִיַּד אֹיְבֵיהֶם כֹּל יְמֵי הַשּׁוֹפֵט כִּי־יִנָּחֵם יְהוָה מִנַּאֲקָתָם מִפְּנֵי לֹחֲצֵיהֶם וְדֹחֲקֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Now whenever YHWH raised up judges for them,YHWH would be with the judge,and would deliver them from the hand of their enemiesall the days of the judge,for YHWH would feel regret at their moanings, because of their oppressors and their persecutors.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּמוֹת הַשּׁוֹפֵט יָשֻׁבוּ וְהִשְׁחִיתוּ מֵאֲבוֹתָם לָלֶכֶת אַחֲרֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לְעָבְדָם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לָהֶם לֹא הִפִּילוּ מִמַּעַלְלֵיהֶם וּמִדַּרְכָּם הַקָּשָׁה׃
verses.english: But it would be, upon the death of the judge:they would return and do ruin, more than their fathers,by walking after other gods,by serving them and by bowing down to them;they would not let any of their actions or their stubborn path fall away.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר יַעַן אֲשֶׁר עָבְרוּ הַגּוֹי הַזֶּה אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִי אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם וְלֹא שָׁמְעוּ לְקוֹלִי׃
verses.english: So YHWH’s anger flared up against Israel,and he said:Because this nation has crossed my covenant that I commanded their fathers,and has not hearkened to my voice,

verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי לֹא אוֹסִיף לְהוֹרִישׁ אִישׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם מִן־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר־עָזַב יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: for my part, I will not continue to dispossess any before themfrom the nations that Yehoshua left behind when he died—

verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן נַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲשֹׁמְרִים הֵם אֶת־דֶּרֶךְ יְהוָה לָלֶכֶת בָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמְרוּ אֲבוֹתָם אִם־לֹא׃
verses.english: in order to test Israel through them,whether they will keep the way of YHWH, to walk in it,as their fathers kept, or not.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּנַּח יְהוָה אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה לְבִלְתִּי הוֹרִישָׁם מַהֵר וְלֹא נְתָנָם בְּיַד־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ׃
verses.english: So YHWH let these nations stayand did not dispossess them quickly,neither did he give them into the hand of Yehoshua.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר הִנִּיחַ יְהוָה לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדְעוּ אֵת כָּל־מִלְחֲמוֹת כְּנָעַן׃
verses.english: And these are the nations that YHWH let remainto test Israel through them,all those who knew nothing of all the battles over Canaan,

verses.hebrew: רַק לְמַעַן דַּעַת דֹּרוֹת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לְלַמְּדָם מִלְחָמָה רַק אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנִים לֹא יְדָעוּם׃
verses.english: only for the sake of knowledge of the Children of Israel’s generations,to teach them war—only those who previously had not known them:

verses.hebrew: חֲמֵשֶׁת סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וְכָל־הַכְּנַעֲנִי וְהַצִּידֹנִי וְהַחִוִּי יֹשֵׁב הַר הַלְּבָנוֹן מֵהַר בַּעַל חֶרְמוֹן עַד לְבוֹא חֲמָת׃
verses.english: the five Philistine overlord [cities]and all the Canaanites and the Sidonians and the Hivvites, the settled-folk of the highlands of the Levanon,from the mount of Baal Hermon to Levo-Hamat.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ לְנַסּוֹת בָּם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל לָדַעַת הֲיִשְׁמְעוּ אֶת־מִצְוֺת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתָם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁה׃
verses.english: They were to test Israel through them,to know whether they would hearken to the commandments of YHWHwhich he had commanded their fathers, by the hand of Moshe.

verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָשְׁבוּ בְּקֶרֶב הַכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִתִּי וְהָאֱמֹרִי וְהַפְּרִזִּי וְהַחִוִּי וְהַיְבוּסִי׃
verses.english: So the Children of Israel settled amid the Canaanites,the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites,the Hivvites, and the Yevusites;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לָהֶם לְנָשִׁים וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם נָתְנוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: they took their daughters for themselves as wives,while their own daughters they gave to their sons,and they served their gods.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיִּשְׁכְּחוּ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרוֹת׃
verses.english: And the Children of Israel did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH;they forgot YHWH their Godand served the Baals and the Ashera-poles The term for this goddess is often interchangeable here with a cult object. However, it is more probable that the name in this passage should be read as “Astarte,” who is more commonly paired with the Baals..

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרַם נַהֲרָיִם וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: So the anger of YHWH flared up against Israel,and he sold theminto the hand of Cushan Rish’atayim/Nubian Double-Wickedness,king of Aram of the Two Rivers,and the Children of Israel served Cushan Rish’atayim for eight years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהוָה מוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם אֵת עָתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז אֲחִי כָלֵב הַקָּטֹן מִמֶּנּוּ׃
verses.english: And the Children of Israel cried out to YHWH,so YHWH raised up a deliverer for the Children of Israel, and he delivered them:Otniel son of Kenaz,brother of Calev, one younger than he.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי עָלָיו רוּחַ־יְהוָה וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּצֵא לַמִּלְחָמָה וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתַיִם מֶלֶךְ אֲרָם וַתָּעָז יָדוֹ עַל כּוּשַׁן רִשְׁעָתָיִם׃
verses.english: Now there [came] upon him the rushing-spirit of YHWH;he led Israel as judge and went out to battle,and YHWH gave into his hand Cushan Rish’atayim king of Aram,and his hand was powerful against Cushan Rish’atayim.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וַיָּמָת עָתְנִיאֵל בֶּן־קְנַז׃
verses.english: The land was quiet for forty years;then Otniel son of Kenaz died.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיְחַזֵּק יְהוָה אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל כִּי־עָשׂוּ אֶת־הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה׃
verses.english: But the Children of Israel continued to do what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,and so YHWH strengthened Eglon king of Moav over Israel,since they had done what was evil in the eyes of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱסֹף אֵלָיו אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּךְ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֶת־עִיר הַתְּמָרִים׃
verses.english: He gathered the Children of Ammon and Amalek to him;then he went and struck Israel,and he took possession of the Town of Date-Palms.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ־מוֹאָב שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: And the Children of Israel served Eglon king of Moav for eighteen years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה וַיָּקֶם יְהוָה לָהֶם מוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־אֵהוּד בֶּן־גֵּרָא בֶּן־הַיְמִינִי אִישׁ אִטֵּר יַד־יְמִינוֹ וַיִּשְׁלְחוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּיָדוֹ מִנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב׃
verses.english: And the Children of Israel cried out to YHWH,so YHWH raised up a deliverer for them:Ehud. son of Gera. , a Binyaminite,a man restricted in his right hand.And the Children of Israel sent a tribute-gift by his hand to Eglon king of Moav.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ לוֹ אֵהוּד חֶרֶב וְלָהּ שְׁנֵי פֵיוֹת גֹּמֶד אָרְכָּהּ וַיַּחְגֹּר אוֹתָהּ מִתַּחַת לְמַדָּיו עַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ׃
verses.english: Ehud made himself a sword;it had two mouths, a gomed Pronounced GO-med. It measured a little over a foot long, corresponding to what the ancients called a “short sword.” its length,and he strapped it under his garb, over his right thigh.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּקְרֵב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה לְעֶגְלוֹן מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וְעֶגְלוֹן אִישׁ בָּרִיא מְאֹד׃
verses.english: Then he brought near the tribute-gift to Eglon king of Moav—now Eglon was an exceedingly well-nourished often understood as “fat” and hence playing up the burlesque aspects of the story, here may be meant to contrast the victorious Moabites with the oppressed Israelites. The same word was also used to describe the hale and healthy cows of the Pharaoh’s dream in Gen. 41:2,4,18, and 20. man—

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר כִּלָּה לְהַקְרִיב אֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וַיְשַׁלַּח אֶת־הָעָם נֹשְׂאֵי הַמִּנְחָה׃
verses.english: and it was, when he had finished bringing near the tribute-gift,that he sent away the people, those bearing the tribute-gift,

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא שָׁב מִן־הַפְּסִילִים אֲשֶׁר אֶת־הַגִּלְגָּל וַיֹּאמֶר דְּבַר־סֵתֶר לִי אֵלֶיךָ הַמֶּלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָס וַיֵּצְאוּ מֵעָלָיו כָּל־הָעֹמְדִים עָלָיו׃
verses.english: while he himself returned from the carved-images, those near Gilgal,and said:I have a secret message). for you, O King!He said:Hush!And they went out from him, all who were standing [in attendance] around him.

verses.hebrew: וְאֵהוּד בָּא אֵלָיו וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁב בַּעֲלִיַּת הַמְּקֵרָה אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵהוּד דְּבַר־אֱלֹהִים לִי אֵלֶיךָ וַיָּקָם מֵעַל הַכִּסֵּא׃
verses.english: When Ehud came to him, he was sitting in the cool upper-chamber that he had, alone.And Ehud said:I have a message from God for you!He arose from his throne which in modern Hebrew means “chair,” rarely has such an everyday usage in the Bible.,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֵהוּד אֶת־יַד שְׂמֹאלוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַחֶרֶב מֵעַל יֶרֶךְ יְמִינוֹ וַיִּתְקָעֶהָ בְּבִטְנוֹ׃
verses.english: and Ehud stretched out his left hand,and took the sword from on his right thighand thrust it into his belly.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גַם־הַנִּצָּב אַחַר הַלַּהַב וַיִּסְגֹּר הַחֵלֶב בְּעַד הַלַּהַב כִּי לֹא שָׁלַף הַחֶרֶב מִבִּטְנוֹ וַיֵּצֵא הַפַּרְשְׁדֹנָה׃
verses.english: Even the grip entered after the flashing-blade,so that the fat closed up behind the blade,for he did not draw the sword from his belly,and the feces) as “vestibule,” through which Ehud exited. came out.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא אֵהוּד הַמִּסְדְּרוֹנָה וַיִּסְגֹּר דַּלְתוֹת הָעַלִיָּה בַּעֲדוֹ וְנָעָל׃
verses.english: Then Ehud went out toward the porch note the rhyme with the rare word in the previous verse, which gives the story a distinct tone.and closed the doors of the upper-chamber after himself, and bolted them.

verses.hebrew: וְהוּא יָצָא וַעֲבָדָיו בָּאוּ וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה נְעֻלוֹת וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַךְ מֵסִיךְ הוּא אֶת־רַגְלָיו בַּחֲדַר הַמְּקֵרָה׃
verses.english: Once he had gone out, his servants came back,and they saw that here, the doors of the upper-chamber were bolted,so they said:Surely he is “covering his feet” in the cool inner-room!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּחִילוּ עַד־בּוֹשׁ וְהְנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ פֹתֵחַ דַּלְתוֹת הָעֲלִיָּה וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־הַמַּפְתֵּחַ וַיִּפְתָּחוּ וְהִנֵּה אֲדֹנֵיהֶם נֹפֵל אַרְצָה מֵת׃
verses.english: They waited-anxiously until it was shamefully-late,and here, he was not opening the doors of the upper-chamber,so they took the key and opened [them] up—and here was their lord, fallen on the ground, dead!

verses.hebrew: וְאֵהוּד נִמְלַט עַד הִתְמַהְמְהָם וְהוּא עָבַר אֶת־הַפְּסִילִים וַיִּמָּלֵט הַשְּׂעִירָתָה׃
verses.english: As for Ehud, he had escaped while they tarried;he crossed by the carved-images, and escaped to Se’ira.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּבוֹאוֹ וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיֵּרְדוּ עִמּוֹ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָהָר וְהוּא לִפְנֵיהֶם׃
verses.english: Now it was, when he came [there],that he gave a thrusting-blast on the shofar, The ram’s horn, usually sounded in battle. in the highlands of Efrayim,and the Children of Israel went down with him from the highlands, with him ahead of them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רִדְפוּ אַחֲרַי כִּי־נָתַן יְהוָה אֶת־אֹיְבֵיכֶם אֶת־מוֹאָב בְּיֶדְכֶם וַיֵּרְדוּ אַחֲרָיו וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְמוֹאָב וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ אִישׁ לַעֲבֹר׃
verses.english: He said to them:Come down with LXX, for MT ridfu, “pursue.” after me,for YHWH has given your enemies, Moav, into your hand!They went down after himand took the Jordan crossings from Moav;they did not let a man cross.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכּוּ אֶת־מוֹאָב בָּעֵת הַהִיא כַּעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ כָּל־שָׁמֵן וְכָל־אִישׁ חָיִל וְלֹא נִמְלַט אִישׁ׃
verses.english: And they struck Moav at that time—about ten thousand men,all stout ones, all men of valor;not a man escaped.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּכָּנַע מוֹאָב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא תַּחַת יַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: Thus Moav was humbled at that time under the hand of Israel.And the land was quiet for eighty years.

verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרָיו הָיָה שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת וַיַּךְ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת אִישׁ בְּמַלְמַד הַבָּקָר וַיֹּשַׁע גַּם־הוּא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: After him was Shamgar son of Anat:he struck the Philistines, six hundred men, with an ox-goad a root that usually means “to learn” or, in another form, “to teach.” Klein understands its usage here as suggesting the thought “I’ll teach the enemy a thing or two.”;thus he too delivered Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וְאֵהוּד מֵת׃
verses.english: But the Children of Israel again did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,and Ehud was dead.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְכְּרֵם יְהוָה בְּיַד יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנַעַן אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ בְּחָצוֹר וְשַׂר־צְבָאוֹ סִיסְרָא וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בַּחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם׃
verses.english: So YHWH sold them into the hand of Yavin trad. English “Jabin.” king of Canaan, who reigned as king in Hatzor trad. English “Hazor,” the strategically and economically important city in the north of Israel, above the Sea of Galilee. An alternate tradition recounts the city’s destruction in Josh. 11:1–11. ;the commander of his armed-forces was Sisera “official” or “eunuch.” .Now he sat [enthroned] at Haroshet of the Nations.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב־בַּרְזֶל לוֹ וְהוּא לָחַץ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחָזְקָה עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: And the Children of Israel cried out to YHWH,for he had nine hundred iron chariots,and he had been oppressing the Children of Israel strongly for twenty years.

verses.hebrew: וּדְבוֹרָה אִשָּׁה נְבִיאָה אֵשֶׁת לַפִּידוֹת הִיא שֹׁפְטָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃
verses.english: Now Devora trad. English “Deborah.” The name means “bee” but is also reminiscent of davar, “[divine] word”—appropriate for a prophet. See also 5:12, “speak forth [dabberi] a song.” was a prophet woman, wife of Lappidot “torches” is sometimes metaphorical for lightning flashes. The fiery connotations of this word have led some to identify him with the general Barak (“Lightning”). The phrase “wife of Lappidot” has been read by some as “a fiery woman,” but the form here generally calls for a proper name./Torches;she was judging Israel at that time.

verses.hebrew: וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת תַּחַת־תֹּמֶר דְּבוֹרָה בֵּין הָרָמָה וּבֵין בֵּית־אֵל בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַמִּשְׁפָּט׃
verses.english: She was sitting [as judge] under the Palm of Devora, between Rama and Bet-El, in the highlands of Efrayim,and the Children of Israel would come up to her for judgment.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם מִקֶּדֶשׁ נַפְתָּלִי וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הֲלֹא צִוָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵךְ וּמָשַׁכְתָּ בְּהַר תָּבוֹר וְלָקַחְתָּ עִמְּךָ עֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִבְּנֵי נַפְתָּלִי וּמִבְּנֵי זְבֻלוּן׃
verses.english: She sent and called for Barak/Lightning son of Avino’am, from Kedesh in Naftali,and she said to him:Has not YHWH, the God of Israel, charged you?Go deploy at Mount Tavor,and take with you ten thousand men from the children of Naftali and from the Children of Zevulun;

verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁכְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן אֶת־סִיסְרָא שַׂר־צְבָא יָבִין וְאֶת־רִכְבּוֹ וְאֶת־הֲמוֹנוֹ וּנְתַתִּיהוּ בְּיָדֶךָ׃
verses.english: I will deploy against you, at Wadi Kishon an east-west brook which empties into the Mediterranean, east of today’s Haifa. In I Kings 18:40 Eliyyahu (Elijah) will slaughter the prophets of Baal there., Sisera, the commander of Yavin’s forces, along with his chariotry and his throng,and I will give him into your hand.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ בָּרָק אִם־תֵּלְכִי עִמִּי וְהָלָכְתִּי וְאִם־לֹא תֵלְכִי עִמִּי לֹא אֵלֵךְ׃
verses.english: Barak said to her:If you go with me, I will go,but if you do not go with me, I will not go!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר הָלֹךְ אֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ אֶפֶס כִּי לֹא תִהְיֶה תִּפְאַרְתְּךָ עַל־הַדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ כִּי בְיַד־אִשָּׁה יִמְכֹּר יְהוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתָּקָם דְּבוֹרָה וַתֵּלֶך עִם־בָּרָק קֶדְשָׁה׃
verses.english: She said:I will go, yes, go go.” with you;but it will not be your glory on the way that you are going.Rather, it is into the hand of a womanthat YHWH will sell Sisera!And Devora arose and went with Barak to Kedesh.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּזְעֵק בָּרָק אֶת־זְבוּלֻן וְאֶת־נַפְתָּלִי קֶדְשָׁה וַיַּעַל בְּרַגְלָיו עֲשֶׂרֶת אַלְפֵי אִישׁ וַתַּעַל עִמּוֹ דְּבוֹרָה׃
verses.english: So Barak called up Zevulun and Naftali to Kedesh,and behind him came up ten thousand men,while Devora came up with them.

verses.hebrew: וְחֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי נִפְרָד מִקַּיִן מִבְּנֵי חֹבָב חֹתֵן מֹשֶׁה וַיֵּט אָהֳלוֹ עַד־אֵלוֹן בצענים [בְּצַעֲנַנִּים] אֲשֶׁר אֶת־קֶדֶשׁ׃
verses.english: —Now Hever the Kenite had parted from the Kenites,from the Children of Hovav, Moshe’s father-in-law;he had spread his tent as far as the oak in Tzaananim, which is near Kedesh.—

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְסִיסְרָא כִּי עָלָה בָּרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם הַר־תָּבוֹר׃
verses.english: And Sisera was told that Barak son of Avino’am had come up to Mount Tavor,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּזְעֵק סִיסְרָא אֶת־כָּל־רִכְבּוֹ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת רֶכֶב בַּרְזֶל וְאֶת־כָּל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ מֵחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם אֶל־נַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃
verses.english: so Sisera summoned all his chariotry, nine hundred iron chariots,and all the fighting-people who were with him,from Haroshet of the Nations to Wadi Kishon.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּבֹרָה אֶל־בָּרָק קוּם כִּי זֶה הַיּוֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַן יְהוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא בְּיָדֶךָ הֲלֹא יְהוָה יָצָא לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֵּרֶד בָּרָק מֵהַר תָּבוֹר וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ אַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: Devora said to Barak:Arise, for this is the day that YHWH is giving Sisera into your hand!Does not YHWH go out [to war] before you?So Barak came down from Mount Tavor,with ten thousand men behind him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּהָם יְהוָה אֶת־סִיסְרָא וְאֶת־כָּל־הָרֶכֶב וְאֶת־כָּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה לְפִי־חֶרֶב לִפְנֵי בָרָק וַיֵּרֶד סִיסְרָא מֵעַל הַמֶּרְכָּבָה וַיָּנָס בְּרַגְלָיו׃
verses.english: And YHWH panicked Sisera and all the chariotry and all the camp, with the mouth of the sword, before Barak,and Sisera got down from the chariot and fled on foot.

verses.hebrew: וּבָרָק רָדַף אַחֲרֵי הָרֶכֶב וְאַחֲרֵי הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד חֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם וַיִּפֹּל כָּל־מַחֲנֵה סִיסְרָא לְפִי־חֶרֶב לֹא נִשְׁאַר עַד־אֶחָד׃
verses.english: Now Barak was pursuing after the chariotry and after the camp, as far as Haroshet of the Nations,while all the camp of Sisera fell by the mouth of the sword;not even one was left.

verses.hebrew: וְסִיסְרָא נָס בְּרַגְלָיו אֶל־אֹהֶל יָעֵל אֵשֶּׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי כִּי שָׁלוֹם בֵּין יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־חָצוֹר וּבֵין בֵּית חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי׃
verses.english: Now Sisera had fled on foot, to the tent of Ya’el trad. English “Jael.” Like some other biblical names, especially of women, this refers admiringly to an animal, the ibex or mountain goat., the wife of Hever the Kenite,for there was peace between Yavin king of Hatzor and the house of Hever the Kenite.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרַאת סִיסְרָא וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו סוּרָה אֲדֹנִי סוּרָה אֵלַי אַל־תִּירָא וַיָּסַר אֵלֶיהָ הָאֹהֱלָה וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ בַּשְּׂמִיכָה׃
verses.english: Ya’el came out to meet Siseraand said to him:Do turn aside, my lord, do turn aside to me, do not be afraid!So he turned aside to her, to the tent,and she covered him with a blanket.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הַשְׁקִינִי־נָא מְעַט־מַיִם כִּי צָמֵאתִי וַתִּפְתַּח אֶת־נֹאוד הֶחָלָב וַתַּשְׁקֵהוּ וַתְּכַסֵּהוּ׃
verses.english: He said to her:Now let me drink a little water, for I am thirsty!She opened a skin of milk, gave him drink, and covered him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ עֲמֹד פֶּתַח הָאֹהֶל וְהָיָה אִם־אִישׁ יָבוֹא וּשְׁאֵלֵךְ וְאָמַר הֲיֵשׁ־פֹּה אִישׁ וְאָמַרְתְּ אָיִן׃
verses.english: Then he said to her:Stand at the entrance to the tent,and let it be: if anyone comes and asks you, and says:Is there anyone here?you are to say: Nobody.

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת־חֶבֶר אֶת־יְתַד הָאֹהֶל וַתָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַמַּקֶּבֶת בְּיָדָהּ וַתָּבוֹא אֵלָיו בַּלָּאט וַתִּתְקַע אֶת־הַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ וַתִּצְנַח בָּאָרֶץ וְהוּא־נִרְדָּם וַיָּעַף וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: Then Ya’el, the wife of Hever, took a tent peg, and put a hammer in her hand,and came to him silentlyand thrust the peg into his temple, so that it went down into the ground—now he had been sound asleep, for he was weary—and he died.

verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה בָרָק רֹדֵף אֶת־סִיסְרָא וַתֵּצֵא יָעֵל לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֵךְ וְאַרְאֶךָּ אֶת־הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּה מְבַקֵּשׁ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וְהִנֵּה סִיסְרָא נֹפֵל מֵת וְהַיָּתֵד בְּרַקָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: Now here, Barak was pursuing Sisera,and Ya’el came out to meet him and said to him:Come, I will show you the man whom you are seeking.He came to her, and here was Sisera fallen dead, with the peg in his temple!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכְנַע אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So on that day God humbled Yavin king of Canaan before the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶךְ יַד בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלוֹךְ וְקָשָׁה עַל יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן עַד אֲשֶׁר הִכְרִיתוּ אֵת יָבִין מֶלֶךְ־כְּנָעַן׃
verses.english: And the hand of the Children of Israel went harder [and harder] against Yavin king of Canaan,until they had [completely] cut off Yavin king of Canaan.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּשַׁר דְּבוֹרָה וּבָרָק בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: And Devora sang, along with Barak son of Avino’am, on that day, saying:

verses.hebrew: בִּפְרֹעַ פְּרָעוֹת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּהִתְנַדֵּב עָם בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: When war-loosened [hair] is loose in Israel,when fighting-people present themselves—bless YHWH!

verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ מְלָכִים הַאֲזִינוּ רֹזְנִים אָנֹכִי לַיהוָה אָנֹכִי אָשִׁירָה אֲזַמֵּר לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Hearken, O kings,give ear, O princes—I, to YHWH I will sing,I will give praise to YHWH, the God of Israel!

verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּצֵאתְךָ מִשֵּׂעִיר בְּצַעְדְּךָ מִשְּׂדֵה אֱדוֹם אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה גַּם־שָׁמַיִם נָטָפוּ גַּם־עָבִים נָטְפוּ מָיִם׃
verses.english: YHWH, in your going out from Se’ir,in your striding forth from the Steppes of Edom,the earth quaked with this meaning is attested only in Arabic; it may instead connote something closer to the watery images to follow., the heavens too dripped,the clouds too dripped water,

verses.hebrew: הָרִים נָזְלוּ מִפְּנֵי יְהוָה זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: the mountains shook before YHWH, the One of Sinai,before YHWH, the God of Israel!

verses.hebrew: בִּימֵי שַׁמְגַּר בֶּן־עֲנָת בִּימֵי יָעֵל חָדְלוּ אֳרָחוֹת וְהֹלְכֵי נְתִיבוֹת יֵלְכוּ אֳרָחוֹת עֲקַלְקַלּוֹת׃
verses.english: In the days of Shamgar son of Anat,in the days of Ya’el, the caravans for orahot (paths). ceased,those who walked on roadswalked on twisting paths.

verses.hebrew: חָדְלוּ פְרָזוֹן בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל חָדֵלּוּ עַד שַׁקַּמְתִּי דְּבוֹרָה שַׁקַּמְתִּי אֵם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: The villagers ceased,they ceased in Israel,until you arose, Devora,you arose, a mother in Israel!

verses.hebrew: יִבְחַר אֱלֹהִים חֲדָשִׁים אָז לָחֶם שְׁעָרִים מָגֵן אִם־יֵרָאֶה וָרֹמַח בְּאַרְבָּעִים אֶלֶף בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: He chose new gods—then there was battle in the gates.Was shield seen, or spear,among forty thousand in Israel?

verses.hebrew: לִבִּי לְחוֹקְקֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמִּתְנַדְּבִים בָּעָם בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: My heart was toward the decree-makers in Israel,those presenting themselves among the people,bless YHWH!

verses.hebrew: רֹכְבֵי אֲתֹנוֹת צְחֹרוֹת יֹשְׁבֵי עַל־מִדִּין וְהֹלְכֵי עַל־דֶּרֶךְ שִׂיחוּ׃
verses.english: O those who ride on white she-asses,those who sit on cloths,those who walk on the way,report [it]!

verses.hebrew: מִקּוֹל מְחַצְצִים בֵּין מַשְׁאַבִּים שָׁם יְתַנּוּ צִדְקוֹת יְהוָה צִדְקֹת פִּרְזֹנוֹ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אָז יָרְדוּ לַשְּׁעָרִים עַם־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: At the sound of the trumpets by the water-drawers to a common root for “trumpet,” and likewise reading the other noun as coming from the verb for drawing water (sh-’-b), understanding it with LXX as representing the lowest rung of society.,there they retell the righteous-acts of YHWH,the righteous-acts for his villagers in Israel.Then they went down to the gates,the fighting-people of YHWH.

verses.hebrew: עוּרִי עוּרִי דְּבוֹרָה עוּרִי עוּרִי דַּבְּרִי־שִׁיר קוּם בָּרָק וּשֲׁבֵה שֶׁבְיְךָ בֶּן־אֲבִינֹעַם׃
verses.english: Bestir, bestir yourself, Devora!Bestir, bestir yourself, speak forth a song!Arise, Barak,and capture your captives, O son of Avino’am!

verses.hebrew: אָז יְרַד שָׂרִיד לְאַדִּירִים עָם יְהוָה יְרַד־לִי בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃
verses.english: Then the remnant went down against the powerful,the fighting-people of YHWH went down for me against the mighty!

verses.hebrew: מִנִּי אֶפְרַיִם שָׁרְשָׁם בַּעֲמָלֵק אַחֲרֶיךָ בִנְיָמִין בַּעֲמָמֶיךָ מִנִּי מָכִיר יָרְדוּ מְחֹקְקִים וּמִזְּבוּלֻן מֹשְׁכִים בְּשֵׁבֶט סֹפֵר׃
verses.english: From Efrayim, their root in Amalek,after you, Binyamin, among your people!From Makhir, the decree-makers went down,and from Zevulun, leaders with the census-counter’s staff.

verses.hebrew: וְשָׂרַי בְּיִשָּׂשכָר עִם־דְּבֹרָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר כֵּן בָּרָק בָּעֵמֶק שֻׁלַּח בְּרַגְלָיו בִּפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדֹלִים חִקְקֵי־לֵב׃
verses.english: Rulers in Yissakhar trad. English “Issachar.” Amit (2004) notes the likelihood that this should read “Naftali,” given the connection to Barak and other factors. beside Devora,as Yissakhar, so Barak,in the valley, sent out behind him.In the tribal divisions of Re’uvenwas great soul searching:

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה יָשַׁבְתָּ בֵּין הַמִּשְׁפְּתַיִם לִשְׁמֹעַ שְׁרִקוֹת עֲדָרִים לִפְלַגּוֹת רְאוּבֵן גְּדוֹלִים חִקְרֵי־לֵב׃
verses.english: why did you sit between the sheepfolds,hearkening to whistling for flocks?At the tribal divisions of Re’uvenwas great soul searching.

verses.hebrew: גִּלְעָד בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן שָׁכֵן וְדָן לָמָּה יָגוּר אֳנִיּוֹת אָשֵׁר יָשַׁב לְחוֹף יַמִּים וְעַל מִפְרָצָיו יִשְׁכּוֹן׃
verses.english: In Gil’ad, across the Jordan he dwelt,and Dan—why did he sojourn in ships?Asher sat by the shore of the sea,by his landing-place he dwelt.

verses.hebrew: זְבֻלוּן עַם חֵרֵף נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת וְנַפְתָּלִי עַל מְרוֹמֵי שָׂדֶה׃
verses.english: Zevulun—a people risking life amid dying;Naftali—upon the risen terraces of the field.

verses.hebrew: בָּאוּ מְלָכִים נִלְחָמוּ אָז נִלְחֲמוּ מַלְכֵי כְנַעַן בְּתַעְנַךְ עַל־מֵי מְגִדּוֹ בֶּצַע כֶּסֶף לֹא לָקָחוּ׃
verses.english: Kings came, they waged battle,then they waged battle, the kings of Canaan,at Ta’nakh, by Megiddo (Hill of) Megiddo.’s waters—profit of silver they took none.

verses.hebrew: מִן־שָׁמַיִם נִלְחָמוּ הַכּוֹכָבִים מִמְּסִלּוֹתָם נִלְחֲמוּ עִם־סִיסְרָא׃
verses.english: From the heavens the stars waged battle,from their courses they waged battle with Sisera.

verses.hebrew: נַחַל קִישׁוֹן גְּרָפָם נַחַל קְדוּמִים נַחַל קִישׁוֹן תִּדְרְכִי נַפְשִׁי עֹז׃
verses.english: The Wadi Kishon swept away [the foe],the ancient wadi, the Wadi Kishon.—May my being bless to b-r-k, “bless,” more in keeping with the singer’s reflective pauses in the poem (e.g., vv.2, 9, 16). them with strength!

verses.hebrew: אָז הָלְמוּ עִקְּבֵי־סוּס מִדַּהֲרוֹת דַּהֲרוֹת אַבִּירָיו׃
verses.english: Then the horses’ hooves poundedfrom the dashing, the dashing of their war-steeds!

verses.hebrew: אוֹרוּ מֵרוֹז אָמַר מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה אֹרוּ אָרוֹר יֹשְׁבֶיהָ כִּי לֹא־בָאוּ לְעֶזְרַת יְהוָה לְעֶזְרַת יְהוָה בַּגִּבּוֹרִים׃
verses.english: Doomed be Meroz, says YHWH’s messenger,doomed, yes, doomed be her settled-folk,because they did not come to the help of YHWH,to the help of YHWH among the mighty!

verses.hebrew: תְּבֹרַךְ מִנָּשִׁים יָעֵל אֵשֶׁת חֶבֶר הַקֵּינִי מִנָּשִׁים בָּאֹהֶל תְּבֹרָךְ׃
verses.english: May she be blessed among women, Ya’el,wife of Hever the Kenite,among women in tents may she be blessed!

verses.hebrew: מַיִם שָׁאַל חָלָב נָתָנָה בְּסֵפֶל אַדִּירִים הִקְרִיבָה חֶמְאָה׃
verses.english: Water he asked for, milk she gave,in a bowl for the valiant, she brought near cream.

verses.hebrew: יָדָהּ לַיָּתֵד תִּשְׁלַחְנָה וִימִינָהּ לְהַלְמוּת עֲמֵלִים וְהָלְמָה סִיסְרָא מָחֲקָה רֹאשׁוֹ וּמָחֲצָה וְחָלְפָה רַקָּתוֹ׃
verses.english: Her hand to the peg she stretched out,her right-hand to the workmen’s pounder.She pounded Sisera, smashed his head,she shattered and passed it through his temple.

verses.hebrew: בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפַל שָׁכָב בֵּין רַגְלֶיהָ כָּרַע נָפָל בַּאֲשֶׁר כָּרַע שָׁם נָפַל שָׁדוּד׃
verses.english: [?] Between her legs he bent down, he fell, he lay,between her legs he bent down, he fell,where he bent down, there he fell, ravaged!

verses.hebrew: בְּעַד הַחַלּוֹן נִשְׁקְפָה וַתְּיַבֵּב אֵם סִיסְרָא בְּעַד הָאֶשְׁנָב מַדּוּעַ בֹּשֵׁשׁ רִכְבּוֹ לָבוֹא מַדּוּעַ אֶחֱרוּ פַּעֲמֵי מַרְכְּבוֹתָיו׃
verses.english: Through the window she peered,Sisera’s mother wailed through the lattice:For-what-reason comes his chariot [so] shamefully-late?For-what-reason are the beats of his chariots tardy?

verses.hebrew: חַכְמוֹת שָׂרוֹתֶיהָ תַּעֲנֶינָּה אַף־הִיא תָּשִׁיב אֲמָרֶיהָ לָהּ׃
verses.english: The wisest of her attendants gives answer,yes, she sends back her words to her:

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא יִמְצְאוּ יְחַלְּקוּ שָׁלָל רַחַם רַחֲמָתַיִם לְרֹאשׁ גֶּבֶר שְׁלַל צְבָעִים לְסִיסְרָא שְׁלַל צְבָעִים רִקְמָה צֶבַע רִקְמָתַיִם לְצַוְּארֵי שָׁלָל׃
verses.english: Are they not finding, dividing the spoils—a lass literally as “womb” and understand it as contemptuous of women. , two lasses for each warrior chief?Spoils of dyed cloths has Sisera,spoils of dyed embroidered cloth;dyed [tunics], embroidered at the neck,he is taking-as-spoils to form tzavar yishlol at the end of the phrase. ….

verses.hebrew: כֵּן יֹאבְדוּ כָל־אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה וְאֹהֲבָיו כְּצֵאת הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ בִּגְבֻרָתוֹ וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: So perish all your enemies, O YHWH,but let those who love yoube like the emergence of the sun in its might!And the land was quiet for forty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהוָה בְּיַד־מִדְיָן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: But the Children of Israel did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,so YHWH gave them into the hand of Midyan trad. English “Midian,” a region and a people whose primary location was the Hejaz (northwestern Arabia), but who also were found in the Sinai and the Jordan Valley., for seven years.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּעָז יַד־מִדְיָן עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן עָשׂוּ לָהֶם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־הַמִּנְהָרוֹת אֲשֶׁר בֶּהָרִים וְאֶת־הַמְּעָרוֹת וְאֶת־הַמְּצָדוֹת׃
verses.english: And the hand of Midyan was powerful against Israel;[in fear] of Midyan, the Children of Israel made use for themselves of the dens a place hollowed out by water (Burney). that were in the highlands,as well as the caves, as well as the strongholds.

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה אִם־זָרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעָלָה מִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי־קֶדֶם וְעָלוּ עָלָיו׃
verses.english: It would be, whenever Israel would sow seed,that Midyan would go up, along with Amalek and the Children of the East;they would go up against it,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנוּ עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ אֶת־יְבוּל הָאָרֶץ עַד־בּוֹאֲךָ עַזָּה וְלֹא־יַשְׁאִירוּ מִחְיָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֶׂה וָשׁוֹר וַחֲמוֹר׃
verses.english: they would encamp against them and would lay ruin the yield of the ground, as far as where-you-come to Gaza,and they would not leave anything sustaining-life in Israelfor sheep, or for ox, or for donkey.

verses.hebrew: כִּי הֵם וּמִקְנֵיהֶם יַעֲלוּ וְאָהֳלֵיהֶם יבאו [וּבָאוּ] כְדֵי־אַרְבֶּה לָרֹב וְלָהֶם וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם אֵין מִסְפָּר וַיָּבֹאוּ בָאָרֶץ לְשַׁחֲתָהּ׃
verses.english: For they and their acquired-livestock would go up, along with their tents,and they would come like locusts in abundance—[what was] theirs and their camels’ was innumerable—and they came into the land to bring it to ruin.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדַּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְאֹד מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה׃
verses.english: So the Children of Israel became exceedingly impoverished before Midyan,and the Children of Israel cried out to YHWH.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־זָעֲקוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה עַל אֹדוֹת מִדְיָן׃
verses.english: And it was, when the Children of Israel cried out to YHWH, on account of Midyan,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוָה אִישׁ נָבִיא אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כֹּה־אָמַר יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אָנֹכִי הֶעֱלֵיתִי אֶתְכֶם מִמִּצְרַיִם וָאֹצִיא אֶתְכֶם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים׃
verses.english: that YHWH sent a man, a prophet, to the Children of Israel;he said to them:Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel:I myself brought you up from Egypt,and took you out of a house of serfs,

verses.hebrew: וָאַצִּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִצְרַיִם וּמִיַּד כָּל־לֹחֲצֵיכֶם וָאֲגָרֵשׁ אוֹתָם מִפְּנֵיכֶם וָאֶתְּנָה לָכֶם אֶת־אַרְצָם׃
verses.english: and rescued you from the hand of Egyptand from the hand of all your oppressors;I drove them out from before youand gave you their land.

verses.hebrew: וָאֹמְרָה לָכֶם אֲנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם לֹא תִירְאוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם יוֹשְׁבִים בְּאַרְצָם וְלֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּם בְּקוֹלִי׃
verses.english: And I said to you:I am YHWH your God;you are not to hold in awe the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are settling—but you did not hearken to my voice!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה וַיֵּשֶׁב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעָפְרָה אֲשֶׁר לְיוֹאָשׁ אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי וְגִדְעוֹן בְּנוֹ חֹבֵט חִטִּים בַּגַּת לְהָנִיס מִפְּנֵי מִדְיָן׃
verses.english: Now a messenger of YHWH came and sat under the oak that is in Ofra, that belonged to Yoash the Avi’ezrite,while Gid’on trad. English “Gideon.” /Hewer his son was beating down wheat in the winepress,to whisk it away from before Midyan.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא אֵלָיו מַלְּאַךְ יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהוָה עִמְּךָ גִּבּוֹר הֶחָיִל׃
verses.english: And YHWH’s messenger was seen by him;he said to him:YHWH is with you, O mighty-man of valor!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו גִּדְעוֹן בִּי אֲדֹנִי וְיֵשׁ יְהוָה עִמָּנוּ וְלָמָּה מְצָאַתְנוּ כָּל־זֹאת וְאַיֵּה כָל־נִפְלְאֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לֵאמֹר הֲלֹא מִמִּצְרַיִם הֶעֱלָנוּ יְהוָה וְעַתָּה נְטָשָׁנוּ יְהוָה וַיִּתְּנֵנוּ בְּכַף־מִדְיָן׃
verses.english: Gid’on said to him:Please, my lord,if YHWH is with us,why has all this found us?Where are all the wonders which our fathers recounted to us, saying:Was it not from Egypt that YHWH brought us up?Yet now, YHWH has forsaken usand has given us into the grasp of Midyan!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּפֶן אֵלָיו יְהוָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ בְּכֹחֲךָ זֶה וְהוֹשַׁעְתָּ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכַּף מִדְיָן הֲלֹא שְׁלַחְתִּיךָ׃
verses.english: YHWH faced him and said:Go forth in this strength of yoursand deliver Israel from the grasp of Midyan!Have I not sent you?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו בִּי אֲדֹנָי בַּמָּה אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל הִנֵּה אַלְפִּי הַדַּל בִּמְנַשֶּׁה וְאָנֹכִי הַצָּעִיר בְּבֵית אָבִי׃
verses.english: He said:Please, O Lord,whereby shall I deliver Israel?Here, my family is the weakest in Menashe,and I am the youngest in my Father’s House!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהוָה כִּי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּךְ וְהִכִּיתָ אֶת־מִדְיָן כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד׃
verses.english: YHWH said to him:Indeed, I will be with you;you will strike down Midyan as [if they were] one man!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לִּי אוֹת שָׁאַתָּה מְדַבֵּר עִמִּי׃
verses.english: He said to him:Now if I have found favor in your eyes,make me a sign that it is you speaking to me:

verses.hebrew: אַל־נָא תָמֻשׁ מִזֶּה עַד־בֹּאִי אֵלֶיךָ וְהֹצֵאתִי אֶת־מִנְחָתִי וְהִנַּחְתִּי לְפָנֶיךָ וַיֹּאמַר אָנֹכִי אֵשֵׁב עַד שׁוּבֶךָ׃
verses.english: now do not depart from this-place until I come back to youand have brought out my gift can mean a sacrifice of grain; perhaps it appears in a double sense here, given Gid’on’s unawareness of his guest’s true identity. In 3:17 it is the same term used to describe the tribute paid to Eglon, king of Moav. and placed it before you!He said:I will stay until your return.

verses.hebrew: וְגִדְעוֹן בָּא וַיַּעַשׂ גְּדִי־עִזִּים וְאֵיפַת־קֶמַח מַצּוֹת הַבָּשָׂר שָׂם בַּסַּל וְהַמָּרַק שָׂם בַּפָּרוּר וַיּוֹצֵא אֵלָיו אֶל־תַּחַת הָאֵלָה וַיַּגַּשׁ׃
verses.english: So Gid’on came outand made ready a goats’ kid with an efa Pronounced ay-FAH, it was a dry measure, equaling perhaps a bushel. of unleavened meal:the meat he put in a basket, while the broth he put in a boiling-pot,and he took them out to him beneath the oak, and brought them close) is frequently used regarding sacrifices..

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים קַח אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת וְהַנַּח אֶל־הַסֶּלַע הַלָּז וְאֶת־הַמָּרַק שְׁפוֹךְ וַיַּעַשׂ כֵּן׃
verses.english: And God’s messenger said to him:Take the meat and the unleavened bread and place them on this boulder,and the broth, pour out.He did so.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה אֶת־קְצֵה הַמִּשְׁעֶנֶת אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּגַּע בַּבָּשָׂר וּבַמַּצּוֹת וַתַּעַל הָאֵשׁ מִן־הַצּוּר וַתֹּאכַל אֶת־הַבָּשָׂר וְאֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה הָלַךְ מֵעֵינָיו׃
verses.english: And YHWH’s messenger stretched out the tip of the crook) is used in Ps. 23:4 (in KJV, “Thy rod and Thy staff, they comfort me”). that was in his handand touched the meat and the unleavened bread;and fire went up from the rockand consumed the meat and the unleavened bread,while YHWH’s messenger went away from his eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא גִּדְעוֹן כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה הוּא וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֲהָהּ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה כִּי־עַל־כֵּן רָאִיתִי מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים׃
verses.english: Gid’on saw that he was YHWH’s messenger,so Gid’on said:Alas, my Lord YHWH,for now I have seen YHWH’s messenger face to face!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהוָה שָׁלוֹם לְךָ אַל־תִּירָא לֹא תָּמוּת׃
verses.english: YHWH said to him:Peace be to you—do not be afraid; you will not die survive..

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם גִּדְעוֹן מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ יְהוָה שָׁלוֹם עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה עוֹדֶנּוּ בְּעָפְרָת אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי׃
verses.english: Gid’on built there a sacrificial-altar to YHWH,and he called it: YHWH of Peace.Until this day, it is still in Ofra of the Avi’ezrites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יְהוָה קַח אֶת־פַּר־הַשּׁוֹר אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ וּפַר הַשֵּׁנִי שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים וְהָרַסְתָּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל אֲשֶׁר לְאָבִיךָ וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו תִּכְרֹת׃
verses.english: It was on that night that YHWH said to him:Take an ox bull that belongs to your father,a second-born bull, seven years old:you are to tear down the altar of Baal that belongs to your father,and the Ashera-pole (ox), asher (that), and Ashera, and secondarily by u-far ha-sheni sheva’ shanim (“second-born bull, seven years old”). that is next to it you are to cut down,

verses.hebrew: וּבָנִיתָ מִזְבֵּחַ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עַל רֹאשׁ הַמָּעוֹז הַזֶּה בַּמַּעֲרָכָה וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת־הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי וְהַעֲלִיתָ עוֹלָה בַּעֲצֵי הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר תִּכְרֹת׃
verses.english: and you are to build an altar to YHWH your Godon the top of this stronghold in an arrangement [of stones];then you are to take the second-born bulland are to offer it up as an offering-up, with the wood of the Ashera-pole that you cut down.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח גִּדְעוֹן עֲשָׂרָה אֲנָשִׁים מֵעֲבָדָיו וַיַּעַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו יְהוָה וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָרֵא אֶת־בֵּית אָבִיו וְאֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר מֵעֲשׂוֹת יוֹמָם וַיַּעַשׂ לָיְלָה׃
verses.english: Gid’on took ten men from his servantsand did as YHWH had spoken to him.Now it was, because he was too afraid of his Father’s House and of the men of the town to do it during the day,that he did it during the night.[?] bent down: Others “sank.” Note that Heb. k-r-’ can also indicate worship. ravaged: The word is perhaps parallel to the underworld term “wasted” (in the homicidal, not the alcoholic sense). The Hebrew root (sh-d-d) can carry the suggestion of rape along with plunder, appropriate in the sexual role reversal of this story, hence the resemblance between “ravaged” and “ravished.”

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכִּימוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּבֹּקֶר וְהִנֵּה נֻתַּץ מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְהָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו כֹּרָתָה וְאֵת הַפָּר הַשֵּׁנִי הֹעֲלָה עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַבָּנוּי׃
verses.english: The men of the town started-early in the morning,and here, the altar of Baal had been demolished,and the Ashera-pole that was next to it had been cut down,and the second-born bull had been offered up upon the rebuilt altar!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מִי עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּדְרְשׁוּ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ עָשָׂה הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: They said, each one to his fellow:Who did this thing?They made inquiry and searched,and they said:Gid’on son of Yoash did this thing!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר אֶל־יוֹאָשׁ הוֹצֵא אֶת־בִּנְךָ וְיָמֹת כִּי נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבַּח הַבַּעַל וְכִי כָרַת הָאֲשֵׁרָה אֲשֶׁר־עָלָיו׃
verses.english: So the men of the town said to Yoash:Bring out your son, that he may die,because he demolished the altar of Baal,and because he cut down the Ashera-pole that was next to it!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹאָשׁ לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־עָמְדוּ עָלָיו הַאַתֶּם תְּרִיבוּן לַבַּעַל אִם־אַתֶּם תּוֹשִׁיעוּן אוֹתוֹ אֲשֶׁר יָרִיב לוֹ יוּמַת עַד־הַבֹּקֶר אִם־אֱלֹהִים הוּא יָרֶב לוֹ כִּי נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹ׃
verses.english: But Yoash said to all who were standing [in attendance] around him:Will you yourselves strive for Baal?Or will you yourselves deliver him?Whoever strives for him will be put to death by daybreak!If he is a god, let him strive for himselfwhen someone demolishes his altar!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא יְרֻבַּעַל לֵאמֹר יָרֶב בּוֹ הַבַּעַל כִּי נָתַץ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹ׃
verses.english: So they called him from that day on: Yerub-baal/Let-Baal-Strive “shame,” for the Baal part of such names (see also “Ish-Boshet” for “Ish-Baal” in II Sam. 2:8,10). Here, though, they did not, because of the centrality of the name Baal in this episode (Burney)., saying:Let Baal strive with him,because he demolished his altar!

verses.hebrew: וְכָל־מִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וּבְנֵי־קֶדֶם נֶאֶסְפוּ יַחְדָּו וַיַּעַבְרוּ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּעֵמֶק יִזְרְעֶאל׃
verses.english: Now all Midyan and Amalek and the Children of the East gathered together;they crossed over and camped in the Valley of Yizre’el trad. English “Jezreel,” the large, fertile valley in the northern part of Israel..

verses.hebrew: וְרוּחַ יְהוָה לָבְשָׁה אֶת־גִּדְעוֹן וַיִּתְקַע בַּשּׁוֹפָר וַיִזָּעֵק אֲבִיעֶזֶר אַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: But the rushing-spirit of YHWH clothed Gid’on;he gave a blast on the shofar and the Avi’ezrite-clan was summoned after him.

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְאָכִים שָׁלַח בְּכָל־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיִזָּעֵק גַּם־הוּא אַחֲרָיו וּמַלְאָכִים שָׁלַח בְּאָשֵׁר וּבִזְבֻלוּן וּבְנַפְתָּלִי וַיַּעֲלוּ לִקְרָאתָם׃
verses.english: He sent messengers to all of Menashe,and they rallied to the summons, they too, after him,and he sent messengers to Asher, to Zevulun, and to Naftali,and they went up to meet them.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים אִם־יֶשְׁךָ מוֹשִׁיעַ בְּיָדִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃
verses.english: Gid’on said to God:If you wish to deliver Israel by my hand, as you have spoken,

verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מַצִּיג אֶת־גִּזַּת הַצֶּמֶר בַּגֹּרֶן אִם טַל יִהְיֶה עַל־הַגִּזָּה לְבַדָּהּ וְעַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ חֹרֶב וְיָדַעְתִּי כִּי־תוֹשִׁיעַ בְּיָדִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ׃
verses.english: here: I am setting a clipping of wool on the threshing-floor;if dew is on the clipping alone, but on all the ground [it is] dry,then I will knowthat you will deliver Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־כֵן וַיַּשְׁכֵּם מִמָּחֳרָת וַיָּזַר אֶת־הַגִּזָּה וַיִּמֶץ טַל מִן־הַגִּזָּה מְלוֹא הַסֵּפֶל מָיִם׃
verses.english: And it was so.He started-early on the morrow;he wrung out the clippingand drained the dew from the clipping—a bowl full of water.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים אַל־יִחַר אַפְּךָ בִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה אַךְ הַפָּעַם אֲנַסֶּה נָּא־רַק־הַפַּעַם בַּגִּזָּה יְהִי־נָא חֹרֶב אֶל־הַגִּזָּה לְבַדָּהּ וְעַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה־טָּל׃
verses.english: Then Gid’on said to God:Do not let your anger flare up against me,but let me speak just one [more] time:pray let me make a test only one [more] time with the clipping;pray let there be dryness on the clipping alone,but on all the ground let there be dew.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיְהִי־חֹרֶב אֶל־הַגִּזָּה לְבַדָּהּ וְעַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ הָיָה טָל׃
verses.english: And God did so on that night:here was dryness on the clipping alone,but on all the ground there was dew.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁכֵּם יְרֻבַּעַל הוּא גִדְעוֹן וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ וַיַּחֲנוּ עַל־עֵין חֲרֹד וּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן הָיָה־לוֹ מִצָּפוֹן מִגִּבְעַת הַמּוֹרֶה בָּעֵמֶק׃
verses.english: Now Yerub-baal—that is Gid’on—and all the fighting-people who were with him started-early;they camped by En Harod/Spring of Trembling,while the camp of Midyan was north of it,at Giv’at Ha-Moreh/Hill of the Sage, in the valley.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן רַב הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתָּךְ מִתִּתִּי אֶת־מִדְיָן בְּיָדָם פֶּן־יִתְפָּאֵר עָלַי יִשְׂרָאֵל לֵאמֹר יָדִי הוֹשִׁיעָה לִּי׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Gid’on:Too many are the fighting-people who are with youfor me to give Midyan into their hand.—lest Israel honor itself over me, saying:My [own] hand delivered me!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קְרָא נָא בְּאָזְנֵי הָעָם לֵאמֹר מִי־יָרֵא וְחָרֵד יָשֹׁב וְיִצְפֹּר מֵהַר הַגִּלְעָד וַיָּשָׁב מִן־הָעָם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנַיִם אֶלֶף וַעֲשֶׂרֶת אֲלָפִים נִשְׁאָרוּ׃
verses.english: So-now,pray call out in the hearing of the people, saying:Who is fearful and trembling?Let him turn back and depart a verb with uncertain meaning. Some emend to ’-v-r, “cross over,” among others. On the other hand, it sounds like the word for “bird/sparrow,” and so possibly suggests “fly away like a sparrow,” or even “Let him turn back twittering.” from Mount Gil’ad “to be afraid”), given that no “Mount Gil’ad” is attested in the Bible.!So there turned back from the people twenty-two thousand, while ten thousand remained.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן עוֹד הָעָם רָב הוֹרֵד אוֹתָם אֶל־הַמַּיִם וְאֶצְרְפֶנּוּ לְךָ שָׁם וְהָיָה אֲשֶׁר אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ זֶה יֵלֵךְ אִתָּךְ הוּא יֵלֵךְ אִתָּךְ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־אֹמַר אֵלֶיךָ זֶה לֹא־יֵלֵךְ עִמָּךְ הוּא לֹא יֵלֵךְ׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Gid’on:Still the people are too many!Lead them down to the water,that I may refine is a metallurgical term for “smelt, test the mettle.” It may also be a play on the tz-p-r of v.3, since p and f are the same root letter in Hebrew (Boling 1975). them for you there:it will be, [the one] about whom I say to you: This one shall go with you,he shall go with you,and [the one] about whom I say to you: This one shall not go beside you,he shall not go.

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹרֶד אֶת־הָעָם אֶל־הַמָּיִם וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יָלֹק בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ מִן־הַמַּיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר יָלֹק הַכֶּלֶב תַּצִּיג אוֹתוֹ לְבָד וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יִכְרַע עַל־בִּרְכָּיו לִשְׁתּוֹת׃
verses.english: So he led the people down to the water,and YHWH said to Gid’on:Whosoever licks with his tongue from the water, as a dog licks,set him aside,but whosoever crouches on his knees to drink …

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִסְפַּר הַמֲלַקְקִים בְּיָדָם אֶל־פִּיהֶם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וְכֹל יֶתֶר הָעָם כָּרְעוּ עַל־בִּרְכֵיהֶם לִשְׁתּוֹת מָיִם׃
verses.english: Now the number of those who licked, from their hand to their mouth,was three hundred men,while all the rest of the people crouched on their knees to drink water.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן בִּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ הַמֲלַקְקִים אוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם וְנָתַתִּי אֶת־מִדְיָן בְּיָדֶךָ וְכָל־הָעָם יֵלְכוּ אִישׁ לִמְקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: YHWH said to Gid’on:By the three hundred men, those who were licking, I will deliver you;I will give Midyan into your hand,and then all the people will go, each one back to his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־צֵדָה הָעָם בְּיָדָם וְאֵת שׁוֹפְרֹתֵיהֶם וְאֵת כָּל־אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל שִׁלַּח אִישׁ לְאֹהָלָיו וּבִשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ הֶחֱזִיק וּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן הָיָה לוֹ מִתַּחַת בָּעֵמֶק׃
verses.english: So they took the people’s provisions in their hand, along with their shofars,while all the fighting-men of Israel he sent away, each to his tents,but of the three hundred men he kept hold.Now the camp of Midyan was beneath him, in the valley.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו יְהוָה קוּם רֵד בַּמַּחֲנֶה כִּי נְתַתִּיו בְּיָדֶךָ׃
verses.english: And it was on that nightthat YHWH said to him:Arise, go down against the camp,for I have given it into your hand!

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־יָרֵא אַתָּה לָרֶדֶת רֵד אַתָּה וּפֻרָה נַעַרְךָ אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.english: And if you are afraid to go down [to attack],go down, you along with Pura your serving-lad, to the camp,

verses.hebrew: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ מַה־יְדַבֵּרוּ וְאַחַר תֶּחֱזַקְנָה יָדֶיךָ וְיָרַדְתָּ בַּמַּחֲנֶה וַיֵּרֶד הוּא וּפֻרָה נַעֲרוֹ אֶל־קְצֵה הַחֲמֻשִׁים אֲשֶׁר בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.english: and hearken to what they are saying;afterward your hands will be strengthened, so that you may go down against the camp.So he went down, he and Pura his serving-lad, to the edge of the armed men who were in the camp.

verses.hebrew: וּמִדְיָן וַעֲמָלֵק וְכָל־בְּנֵי־קֶדֶם נֹפְלִים בָּעֵמֶק כָּאַרְבֶּה לָרֹב וְלִגְמַלֵּיהֶם אֵין מִסְפָּר כַּחוֹל שֶׁעַל־שְׂפַת הַיָּם לָרֹב׃
verses.english: Now Midyan and Amalek and all the Children of the East were sprawled out in the valley, like locusts in abundance,and their camels had no number,like the sand that is on the shore of the sea in abundance.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ מְסַפֵּר לְרֵעֵהוּ חֲלוֹם וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה חֲלוֹם חָלַמְתִּי וְהִנֵּה צלול [צְלִיל] לֶחֶם שְׂעֹרִים מִתְהַפֵּךְ בְּמַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן וַיָּבֹא עַד־הָאֹהֶל וַיַּכֵּהוּ וַיִּפֹּל וַיַּהַפְכֵהוּ לְמַעְלָה וְנָפַל הָאֹהֶל׃
verses.english: And Gid’on came, and here, a man was recounting a dream to his fellow;he said:Here, I have dreamt a dream,and here, a loaf of barley bread also recalls the verb l-h-m, “to fight/battle”; as Niditch (2008) notes, such word associations are characteristic of dreams. was turning over in the camp of Midyan.It came as far as the tent and struck it, and it fell;it overturned it, upward,and the tent fell down!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן רֵעֵהוּ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵין זֹאת בִּלְתִּי אִם־חֶרֶב גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ אִישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל נָתַן הָאֱלֹהִים בְּיָדוֹ אֶת־מִדְיָן וְאֶת־כָּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה׃
verses.english: His fellow spoke up and said:This is none other than the sword of Gid’on son of Yoash, the man of Israel!God has given Midyan into his hand, yes, the entire camp!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ גִּדְעוֹן אֶת־מִסְפַּר הַחֲלוֹם וְאֶת־שִׁבְרוֹ וַיִּשְׁתָּחוּ וַיָּשָׁב אֶל־מַחֲנֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֹּאמֶר קוּמוּ כִּי־נָתַן יְהוָה בְּיֶדְכֶם אֶת־מַחֲנֵה מִדְיָן׃
verses.english: It was, when Gid’on heard the recounting of the dream and its interpretation,that he bowed low;then he returned to the camp of Israeland said:Arise, for YHWH has given into our hand the camp of Midyan!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּחַץ אֶת־שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ שְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיִּתֵּן שׁוֹפָרוֹת בְּיַד־כֻּלָּם וְכַדִּים רֵקִים וְלַפִּדִים בְּתוֹךְ הַכַּדִּים׃
verses.english: He split up the three hundred men into three companies,and he placed shofars in everyone’s hand along with empty jugs, and torches inside the jugs,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מִמֶּנִּי תִרְאוּ וְכֵן תַּעֲשׂוּ וְהִנֵּה אָנֹכִי בָא בִּקְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה וְהָיָה כַאֲשֶׁר־אֶעֱשֶׂה כֵּן תַּעֲשׂוּן׃
verses.english: and said to them:Look at me and do thus:when I come to the outskirts of the camp,let it be: as I do, so you are to do:

verses.hebrew: וְתָקַעְתִּי בַּשּׁוֹפָר אָנֹכִי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר אִתִּי וּתְקַעְתֶּם בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת גַּם־אַתֶּם סְבִיבוֹת כָּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַאֲמַרְתֶּם לַיהוָה וּלְגִדְעוֹן׃
verses.english: I will sound a blast on the shofar, I and all who are with me,and then you are to sound a blast on the shofars, you as well, all around the entire camp,and you are to say:For YHWH and for Gid’on!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן וּמֵאָה־אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ בִּקְצֵה הַמַּחֲנֶה רֹאשׁ הָאַשְׁמֹרֶת הַתִּיכוֹנָה אַךְ הָקֵם הֵקִימוּ אֶת־הַשֹּׁמְרִים וַיִּתְקְעוּ בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וְנָפוֹץ הַכַּדִּים אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם׃
verses.english: So Gid’on came, along with the hundred men who were with him, to the outskirts of the camp,at the beginning of the middle watch—they had just installed, installed the watchmen—and they sounded blasts on the shofars, with the jugs that were in their hand [ready to be] shattered.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הָרָאשִׁים בַּשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיִּשְׁבְּרוּ הַכַּדִּים וַיַּחֲזִיקוּ בְיַד־שְׂמאוֹלָם בַּלַּפִּדִים וּבְיַד־יְמִינָם הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת לִתְקוֹעַ וַיִּקְרְאוּ חֶרֶב לַיהוָה וּלְגִדְעוֹן׃
verses.english: And the three companies sounded blasts on the shofars, and broke the jugs;they gripped the torches in their left hands,and in their right hands, the shofars, to sound blasts,and called out:A sword for YHWH and for Gid’on!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַמְדוּ אִישׁ תַּחְתָּיו סָבִיב לַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרָץ כָּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּרִיעוּ ויניסו [וַיָּנוּסוּ׃]
verses.english: Then they stood still, each one in his position all around the camp,and the entire camp was on the run;they shouted) can have the meaning “jump up,” hence he uses “awoke with a start.” and they fled.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְקְעוּ שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הַשּׁוֹפָרוֹת וַיָּשֶׂם יְהוָה אֵת חֶרֶב אִישׁ בְּרֵעֵהוּ וּבְכָל־הַמַּחֲנֶה וַיָּנָס הַמַּחֲנֶה עַד־בֵּית הַשִּׁטָּה צְרֵרָתָה עַד שְׂפַת־אָבֵל מְחוֹלָה עַל־טַבָּת׃
verses.english: The three hundred shofars were sounded,and YHWH put each one’s sword against his fellow, that is, against the entire camp, and the entire camp fled as far as Bet-Shitta, toward Tzerera, to the border of Avel-Mehola, near Tabbat.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּעֵק אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִנַּפְתָּלִי וּמִן־אָשֵׁר וּמִן־כָּל־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אַחֲרֵי מִדְיָן׃
verses.english: The men of Israel were mustered from Naftali, from Asher, and from all of Menashe,and they pursued after Midyan.

verses.hebrew: וּמַלְאָכִים שָׁלַח גִּדְעוֹן בְּכָל־הַר אֶפְרַיִם לֵאמֹר רְדוּ לִקְרַאת מִדְיָן וְלִכְדוּ לָהֶם אֶת־הַמַּיִם עַד בֵּית בָּרָה וְאֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּצָּעֵק כָּל־אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם וַיִּלְכְּדוּ אֶת־הַמַּיִם עַד בֵּית בָּרָה וְאֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: Now Gid’on had sent messengers throughout all the highlands of Efrayim, saying:Go down to meet Midyan [in battle], and take the water from them, as far as Bet-Bara and the Jordan!So all the men of Efrayim were mustered, and they captured the water, as far as Bet-Bara and the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכְּדוּ שְׁנֵי־שָׂרֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־עֹרֵב וְאֶת־זְאֵב וַיַּהַרְגוּ אֶת־עוֹרֵב בְּצוּר־עוֹרֵב וְאֶת־זְאֵב הָרְגוּ בְיֶקֶב־זְאֵב וַיִּרְדְּפוּ אֶל־מִדְיָן וְרֹאשׁ־עֹרֵב וּזְאֵב הֵבִיאוּ אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן מֵעֵבֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: And they captured the two commanders of Midyan, Orev/Raven and Ze’ev/Wolf;they killed Orev at Raven’s Rock, while Ze’ev they killed at Wolf’s Vat—for they had pursued as far as Midyan—and the heads of Orev and Ze’ev they brought to Gid’on, from across the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם מָה־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ לְבִלְתִּי קְרֹאות לָנוּ כִּי הָלַכְתָּ לְהִלָּחֵם בְּמִדְיָן וַיְרִיבוּן אִתּוֹ בְּחָזְקָה׃
verses.english: Then the men of Efrayim said to him:What is this thing you have done to us, not calling for uswhen you went to do battle against Midyan?And they strove with him strongly.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם מֶה־עָשִׂיתִי עַתָּה כָּכֶם הֲלוֹא טוֹב עֹלְלוֹת אֶפְרַיִם מִבְצִיר אֲבִיעֶזֶר׃
verses.english: He said to them:What now have I done against you?Are not the gleanings of Efrayim better than the vintage of Avi’ezer?

verses.hebrew: בְּיֶדְכֶם נָתַן אֱלֹהִים אֶת־שָׂרֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־עֹרֵב וְאֶת־זְאֵב וּמַה־יָּכֹלְתִּי עֲשׂוֹת כָּכֶם אָז רָפְתָה רוּחָם מֵעָלָיו בְּדַבְּרוֹ הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: Into your hand God has given the commanders of Midyan, Orev and Ze’ev;what have I been able to do compared to you?And their spirit [of anger] subsided from upon him, when he spoke these words.[of anger]: The word “spirit” (Heb. ru’ah) can include a range of emotional meanings.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גִדְעוֹן הַיַּרְדֵּנָה עֹבֵר הוּא וּשְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ עֲיֵפִים וְרֹדְפִים׃
verses.english: Gid’on came to the Jordan,crossing over, he and the three hundred men who were with him,weary and in pursuit.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְאַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת תְּנוּ־נָא כִּכְּרוֹת לֶחֶם לָעָם אֲשֶׁר בְּרַגְלָי כִּי־עֲיֵפִים הֵם וְאָנֹכִי רֹדֵף אַחֲרֵי זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן׃
verses.english: He said to the men of Sukkot:Now give some round-loaves of bread to the fighting-people who are behind me,for they are weary,while I will pursue after Zevah and Tzalmunna, the kings of Midyan.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שָׂרֵי סֻכּוֹת הֲכַף זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע עַתָּה בְּיָדֶךָ כִּי־נִתֵּן לִצְבָאֲךָ לָחֶם׃
verses.english: The commanders of Sukkot said:Is the grasp of Zevah and Tzalmunna now in your hand,that we should give your forces bread?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גִּדְעוֹן לָכֵן בְּתֵת יְהוָה אֶת־זֶבַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּע בְּיָדִי וְדַשְׁתִּי אֶת־בְּשַׂרְכֶם אֶת־קוֹצֵי הַמִּדְבָּר וְאֶת־הַבַּרְקֳנִים׃
verses.english: Gid’on said:Therefore,when God gives Zevah and Tzalmunna into my hand,I will tread over your flesh with wilderness thorns and with nettles!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מִשָּׁם פְּנוּאֵל וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם כָּזֹאת וַיַּעֲנוּ אוֹתוֹ אַנְשֵׁי פְנוּאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר עָנוּ אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת׃
verses.english: He went up from there to Penuel, and spoke to them like this,and the men of Penuel answered himas the men of Sukkot had answered.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גַּם־לְאַנְשֵׁי פְנוּאֵל לֵאמֹר בְּשׁוּבִי בְשָׁלוֹם אֶתֹּץ אֶת־הַמִּגְדָּל הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: So he said also to the men of Penuel, saying:Upon my return in peace,I will demolish this tower!

verses.hebrew: וְזֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע בַּקַּרְקֹר וּמַחֲנֵיהֶם עִמָּם כַּחֲמֵשֶׁת עָשָׂר אֶלֶף כֹּל הַנּוֹתָרִים מִכֹּל מַחֲנֵה בְנֵי־קֶדֶם וְהַנֹּפְלִים מֵאָה וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף אִישׁ שֹׁלֵף חָרֶב׃
verses.english: Now Zevah and Tzalmunna were in Karkor,and their camps were with them, about fifteen thousand,all who were left from the entire camp of the Children of the East,for those fallen were a hundred and twenty thousand men drawing the sword.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל גִּדְעוֹן דֶּרֶךְ הַשְּׁכוּנֵי בָאֳהָלִים מִקֶּדֶם לְנֹבַח וְיָגְבֳּהָה וַיַּךְ אֶת־הַמַּחֲנֶה וְהַמַּחֲנֶה הָיָה בֶטַח׃
verses.english: And Gid’on went up by the Road of the Tent Dwellers, east of Novah and Yogbeha,and he struck the camp, while the camp was feeling-secure.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנוּסוּ זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע וַיִּרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵיהֶם וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־שְׁנֵי מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן אֶת־זֶבַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּע וְכָל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הֶחֱרִיד׃
verses.english: Zevah and Tzalmunna fled, but he pursued after them,and he captured the two kings of Midyan, Zevah and Tzalmunna,and made the entire camp tremble.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ מִן־הַמִּלְחָמָה מִלְמַעֲלֵה הֶחָרֶס׃
verses.english: Gid’on son of Yoash returned from the battle, from Heres Pass,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכָּד־נַעַר מֵאַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת וַיִּשְׁאָלֵהוּ וַיִּכְתֹּב אֵלָיו אֶת־שָׂרֵי סֻכּוֹת וְאֶת־זְקֵנֶיהָ שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָה אִישׁ׃
verses.english: and he captured a lad from the men of Sukkot, and questioned him,and he wrote out for him [the names of] the commanders of Sukkot and its elders,seventy-seven men.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע אֲשֶׁר חֵרַפְתֶּם אוֹתִי לֵאמֹר הֲכַף זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע עַתָּה בְּיָדֶךָ כִּי נִתֵּן לַאֲנָשֶׁיךָ הַיְּעֵפִים לָחֶם׃
verses.english: Then he came to the men of Sukkotand said:Here are Zevah and Tzalmunna, with whom you mocked me, saying:Is the grasp of Zevah and Tzalmunna now in your hand,that we should give your weary men bread?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־זִקְנֵי הָעִיר וְאֶת־קוֹצֵי הַמִּדְבָּר וְאֶת־הַבַּרְקֳנִים וַיֹּדַע בָּהֶם אֵת אַנְשֵׁי סֻכּוֹת׃
verses.english: So he took the elders of the town, and the wilderness thorns and the nettles,and trod over the men of Sukkot with them,

verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־מִגְדַּל פְּנוּאֵל נָתָץ וַיַּהֲרֹג אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר׃
verses.english: while the tower of Penuel he demolished, and killed the men of the town.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־זֶבַח וְאֶל־צַלְמֻנָּע אֵיפֹה הָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הֲרַגְתֶּם בְּתָבוֹר וַיֹּאמרוּ כָּמוֹךָ כְמוֹהֶם אֶחָד כְּתֹאַר בְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
