verses.english: Then he said to Zevah and Tzalmunna:What about the men whom you killed at Tavor?They said:Like you were they,every one like the appearance of the king’s sons.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמַר אַחַי בְּנֵי־אִמִּי הֵם חַי־יְהוָה לוּ הַחֲיִתֶם אוֹתָם לֹא הָרַגְתִּי אֶתְכֶם׃
verses.english: He said:They were my brothers, the sons of my mother!By the life of YHWH,if [only] you had let them live,I would not have to kill you!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְיֶתֶר בְּכוֹרוֹ קוּם הֲרֹג אוֹתָם וְלֹא־שָׁלַף הַנַּעַר חַרְבּוֹ כִּי יָרֵא כִּי עוֹדֶנּוּ נָעַר׃
verses.english: And he said to Yeter his firstborn:Rise up, kill them!But the lad would not draw his sword,for he was afraid,for he was still a lad.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר זֶבַח וְצַלְמֻנָּע קוּם אַתָּה וּפְגַע־בָּנוּ כִּי כָאִישׁ גְּבוּרָתוֹ וַיָּקָם גִּדְעוֹן וַיַּהֲרֹג אֶת־זֶבַח וְאֶת־צַלְמֻנָּע וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִים אֲשֶׁר בְּצַוְּארֵי גְמַלֵּיהֶם׃
verses.english: Then Zevah and Tzalmunna said:Rise up, you yourself, and attack us,for as the man is, [so] is his might!So Gid’on arose and killed Zevah and Tzalmunna,and he took the crescent-ornaments that were on their camels’ necks.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־גִּדְעוֹן מְשָׁל־בָּנוּ גַּם־אַתָּה גַּם־בִּנְךָ גַּם בֶּן־בְּנֶךָ כִּי הוֹשַׁעְתָּנוּ מִיַּד מִדְיָן׃
verses.english: Now the men of Israel said to Gid’on:Rule over us—so you, so your son, so your son’s son,for you have delivered us from the hand of Midyan!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם גִּדְעוֹן לֹא־אֶמְשֹׁל אֲנִי בָּכֶם וְלֹא־יִמְשֹׁל בְּנִי בָּכֶם יְהוָה יִמְשֹׁל בָּכֶם׃
verses.english: Gid’on said to them:I will not rule over you,my son will not rule over you—YHWH will rule over you!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם גִּדְעוֹן אֶשְׁאֲלָה מִכֶּם שְׁאֵלָה וּתְנוּ־לִי אִישׁ נֶזֶם שְׁלָלוֹ כִּי־נִזְמֵי זָהָב לָהֶם כִּי יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים הֵם׃
verses.english: Then Gid’on said to them:I have a request to request of you:Give me, each one, a ring from his spoils!—for they had gold rings, for they were Yishmaelites.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתוֹן נִתֵּן וַיִּפְרְשׂוּ אֶת־הַשִּׂמְלָה וַיַּשְׁלִיכוּ שָׁמָּה אִישׁ נֶזֶם שְׁלָלוֹ׃
verses.english: They said:We will give, yes, give [them] over.So they spread out a clothand threw there, each one, a ring from his spoils.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִשְׁקַל נִזְמֵי הַזָּהָב אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָל אֶלֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאוֹת זָהָב לְבַד מִן־הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִים וְהַנְּטִפוֹת וּבִגְדֵי הָאַרְגָּמָן שֶׁעַל מַלְכֵי מִדְיָן וּלְבַד מִן־הָעֲנָקוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּצַוְּארֵי גְמַלֵּיהֶם׃
verses.english: Now the weight of the gold rings that he requestedwas a thousand and seven hundred [weights of] gold,aside from the crescents and the pearl-drops and the purple garments that were on the kings of Midyan,and aside from the collars that were around their camels’ necks.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַשׂ אוֹתוֹ גִדְעוֹן לְאֵפוֹד וַיַּצֵּג אוֹתוֹ בְעִירוֹ בְּעָפְרָה וַיִּזְנוּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרָיו שָׁם וַיְהִי לְגִדְעוֹן וּלְבֵיתוֹ לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃
verses.english: And Gid’on made it into an efod;he set it up in his town, in Ofra,and all Israel went whoring after it there.It became a snare for Gid’on and for his house.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכָּנַע מִדְיָן לִפְנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא יָסְפוּ לָשֵׂאת רֹאשָׁם וַתִּשְׁקֹט הָאָרֶץ אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה בִּימֵי גִדְעוֹן׃
verses.english: And Midyan was humbled before the Children of Israel,so that they could no longer lift up their head.And the land was quiet for forty years in the days of Gid’on.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יְרֻבַּעַל בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּבֵיתוֹ׃
verses.english: Yerub-baal son of Yoash went and settled down in his house.

verses.hebrew: וּלְגִדְעוֹן הָיוּ שִׁבְעִים בָּנִים יֹצְאֵי יְרֵכוֹ כִּי־נָשִׁים רַבּוֹת הָיוּ לוֹ׃
verses.english: Now Gid’on had seventy sons issuing from his loins,for he had many wives.

verses.hebrew: וּפִילַגְשׁוֹ אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁכֶם יָלְדָה־לּוֹ גַם־הִיא בֵּן וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־שְׁמוֹ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: As for his concubine, who was in Shekhem, she too bore him a son;he appointed his name Avimelekh/Father-is-King.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת גִּדְעוֹן בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ בְּשֵׂיבָה טוֹבָה וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקֶבֶר יוֹאָשׁ אָבִיו בְּעָפְרָה אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי׃
verses.english: And Gid’on son of Yoash died at a good ripe age,and was buried in the burial place of Yoash his father,in Ofra of the Avi’ezrites.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר מֵת גִּדְעוֹן וַיָּשׁוּבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּזְנוּ אַחֲרֵי הַבְּעָלִים וַיָּשִׂימוּ לָהֶם בַּעַל בְּרִית לֵאלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Now it was, when Gid’on died,that the Children of Israel returned and went whoring after the Baals;they made Baal Berit a god for themselves.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא זָכְרוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם הַמַּצִּיל אוֹתָם מִיַּד כָּל־אֹיְבֵיהֶם מִסָּבִיב׃
verses.english: The Children of Israel did not keep YHWH their God in mind,the one rescuing them from the hand of all their enemies round about,

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־עָשׂוּ חֶסֶד עִם־בֵּית יְרֻבַּעַל גִּדְעוֹן כְּכָל־הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: and they did not act in loyalty with the house of Yerub-baal Gid’on,in accordance with all the good things that he had done for Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־יְרֻבַּעַל שְׁכֶמָה אֶל־אֲחֵי אִמּוֹ וַיְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם וְאֶל־כָּל־מִשְׁפַּחַת בֵּית־אֲבִי אִמּוֹ לֵאמֹר׃
verses.english: Avimelekh trad. English “Abimelech.” son of Yerub-baal went to Shekhem, to his mother’s brothersand spoke to them and to the entire clan of his mother’s Father’s House, saying:

verses.hebrew: דַּבְּרוּ־נָא בְּאָזְנֵי כָל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם מַה־טּוֹב לָכֶם הַמְשֹׁל בָּכֶם שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ כֹּל בְּנֵי יְרֻבַּעַל אִם־מְשֹׁל בָּכֶם אִישׁ אֶחָד וּזְכַרְתֶּם כִּי־עַצְמֵכֶם וּבְשַׂרְכֶם אָנִי׃
verses.english: Now speak in the hearing of all the landowners the plural of Baal, but here used in its human Hebrew meaning of “master, owner.” of Shekhem:What is better for you—for seventy men to rule over you, all of Yerub-baal’s sons,or for one man to rule over you?And keep in mindthat I am your bone and your flesh!

verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֲחֵי־אִמּוֹ עָלָיו בְּאָזְנֵי כָּל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם אֵת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַיֵּט לִבָּם אַחֲרֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי אָמְרוּ אָחִינוּ הוּא׃
verses.english: So his mother’s brothers spoke concerning him, in the hearing of all the landowners of Shekhem,all these words,and their heart inclined after Avimelekh,for they said: He is our brother!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ־לוֹ שִׁבְעִים כֶּסֶף מִבֵּיתּ בַעַל בְּרִית וַיִּשְׂכֹּר בָּהֶם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲנָשִׁים רֵיקִים וּפֹחֲזִים וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרָיו׃
verses.english: So they gave him seventy pieces of silver from the temple-house of Baal Berit,and with them Avimelekh hired some empty and impetuous men;they went [following] after him.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא בֵית־אָבִיו עָפְרָתָה וַיַּהֲרֹג אֶת־אֶחָיו בְּנֵי־יְרֻבַּעַל שִׁבְּעִים אִישׁ עַל־אֶבֶן אֶחָת וַיִּוָּתֵר יוֹתָם בֶּן־יְרֻבַּעַל הַקָּטֹן כִּי נֶחְבָּא׃
verses.english: He came to his Father’s House, to Ofra,and killed his brothers, Yerub-baal’s sons,seventy men on one stone;but Yotam trad. English “Jotham.” son of Yerub-baal, the youngest, was left,for he had hidden himself.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּאָסְפוּ כָּל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וְכָל־בֵּית מִלּוֹא וַיֵּלְכוּ וַיַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְמֶלֶךְ עִם־אֵלוֹן מֻצָּב אֲשֶׁר בִּשְׁכֶם׃
verses.english: Then gathered all the landowners of Shekhem and all of Bet-Millo The name signifies “earth-fill,” possibly describing the supporting structure for a city wall. and went and kinged Avimelekh as king,alongside the oak of the monument that is in Shekhem.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגִּדוּ לְיוֹתָם וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיַּעֲמֹד בְּרֹאשׁ הַר־גְּרִזִים וַיִּשָּׂא קוֹלוֹ וַיִּקְרָא וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְעוּ אֵלַי בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וְיִשְׁמַע אֲלֵיכֶם אֱלֹהִים׃
verses.english: Yotam was told [about it],so he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim one of the two large hills overlooking Shekhem; ironically, in Deut. 27 it is the site of the blessing of Israel.and lifted up his voice and called out;he said to them:Hearken to me, O landowners of Shekhem,that God may hearken to you!

verses.hebrew: הָלוֹךְ הָלְכוּ הָעֵצִים לִמְשֹׁחַ עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לַזַּיִת מלוכה [מָלְכָה] עָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: The trees went, they went to anoint a king over themselves.And they said to the olive:Reign as king over us!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַזַּיִת הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת־דִּשְׁנִי אֲשֶׁר־בִּי יְכַבְּדוּ אֱלֹהִים וַאֲנָשִׁים וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִים׃
verses.english: The olive said to them:Should I be made to leave my luxuriant-oilthrough which gods and men honor themselves,that I should go and hold sway over the trees?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעֵצִים לַתְּאֵנָה לְכִי־אַתְּ מָלְכִי עָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: So the trees said to the fig:You go, reign as king over us!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַתְּאֵנָה הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת־מָתְקִי וְאֶת־תְּנוּבָתִי הַטּוֹבָה וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִים׃
verses.english: The fig said to them:Should I be made to leave my sweetness and my good produce,that I should go and hold sway over the trees?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעֵצִים לַגָּפֶן לְכִי־אַתְּ מלוכי [מָלְכִי] עָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: So the trees said to the grapevine:You go, reign as king over us!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם הַגֶּפֶן הֶחֳדַלְתִּי אֶת־תִּירוֹשִׁי הַמְשַׂמֵּחַ אֱלֹהִים וַאֲנָשִׁים וְהָלַכְתִּי לָנוּעַ עַל־הָעֵצִים׃
verses.english: The grapevine said to them:Should I be made to leave my new-wine,which gives joy to gods and men,that I should go and hold sway over the trees?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ כָל־הָעֵצִים אֶל־הָאָטָד לֵךְ אַתָּה מְלָךְ־עָלֵינוּ׃
verses.english: So all the trees said to the atad: This appears to be a large, wild-looking tree (Zizyphus spina-christi) whose roots destroy those of other fruit trees and whose wood burns well (Hareuveni). It is thus a fine choice as a symbol of the powerful but destructive Avimelekh. Others understand it as a thorny bush such as the boxwood.You go, reign as king over us!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאָטָד אֶל־הָעֵצִים אִם בֶּאֱמֶת אַתֶּם מֹשְׁחִים אֹתִי לְמֶלֶךְ עֲלֵיכֶם בֹּאוּ חֲסוּ בְצִלִּי וְאִם־אַיִן תֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מִן־הָאָטָד וְתֹאכַל אֶת־אַרְזֵי הַלְּבָנוֹן׃
verses.english: The atad said to the trees’s answer. :If [it is] in faithfulness you are anointing me as king over you,come, take refuge in my shade as Gray (1986) reminds us, can also mean “protection.”;but if not—then let fire come forth from the atadand devour the cedars of the Levanon!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אִם־בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְתָמִים עֲשִׂיתֶם וַתַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְאִם־טוֹבָה עֲשִׂיתֶם עִם־יְרֻבַּעַל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ וְאִם־כִּגְמוּל יָדָיו עֲשִׂיתֶם לוֹ׃
verses.english: So-now, if you acted in truth and integritywhen you made Avimelekh king,and if you acted in good-faith with Yerub-baal and with his house,and if you acted in accordance with the dealings of his hands

verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־נִלְחַם אָבִי עֲלֵיכֶם וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ מִנֶּגֶד וַיַּצֵּל אֶתְכֶם מִיַּד מִדְיָן׃
verses.english: —[seeing] that my father did battle for youand threw aside his own life and rescued you from the hand of Midyan,

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם קַמְתֶּם עַל־בֵּית אָבִי הַיּוֹם וַתַּהַרְגוּ אֶת־בָּנָיו שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ עַל־אֶבֶן אֶחָת וַתַּמְלִיכוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בֶּן־אֲמָתוֹ עַל־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם כִּי אֲחִיכֶם הוּא׃
verses.english: yet you, you have risen up against my Father’s House todayand have killed his sons, seventy men on one stone,and have made Avimelekh, son of his maid, king over the landowners of Shekhem, because he is your brother—

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־בֶּאֱמֶת וּבְתָמִים עֲשִׂיתֶם עִם־יְרֻבַּעַל וְעִם־בֵּיתוֹ הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה שִׂמְחוּ בַּאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְיִשְׂמַח גַּם־הוּא בָּכֶם׃
verses.english: so if you have acted in truth and integrity with Yerub-baal and his house this day,may you rejoice in Avimelekh, and may he rejoice in you!

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־אַיִן תֵּצֵא אֵשׁ מֵאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְתֹאכַל אֶת־בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וְאֶת־בֵּית מִלּוֹא וְתֵצֵא אֵשׁ מִבַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וּמִבֵּית מִלּוֹא וְתֹאכַל אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: But if not,may fire come forth from Avimelekhand devour the landowners of Shekhem and Bet-Millo,and may fire come forth from the landowners of Shekhem and Bet-Milloand devour Avimelekh!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּנָס יוֹתָם וַיִּבְרַח וַיֵּלֶךְ בְּאֵרָה וַיֵּשֶׁב שָׁם מִפְּנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אָחִיו׃
verses.english: Then Yotam fled:he ran away and went to Be’er Some suggest modern El-Bireh, south of the Sea of Galilee, but the name is a common one. and settled there,away from the face of Avimelekh his brother.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשַׂר אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: Avimelekh governed Israel for three years.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ רָעָה בֵּין אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּבֵין בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וַיִּבְגְּדוּ בַעֲלֵי־שְׁכֶם בַּאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Then God sent a spirit of evil between Avimelekh and the landowners of Shekhem,and the landowners of Shekhem broke faith with Avimelekh,

verses.hebrew: לָבוֹא חֲמַס שִׁבְעִים בְּנֵי־יְרֻבָּעַל וְדָמָם לָשׂוּם עַל־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲחִיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הָרַג אוֹתָם וְעַל בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם אֲשֶׁר־חִזְּקוּ אֶת־יָדָיו לַהֲרֹג אֶת־אֶחָיו׃
verses.english: so that the wrong [done] the seventy sons of Yerub-baal, and their bloodguilt, might cometo be placed on Avimelekh their brother, who had killed them,and on the landowners of Shekhem,who had strengthened his hands to kill his brothers.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ לוֹ בַעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם מְאָרְבִים עַל רָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים וַיִּגְזְלוּ אֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲבֹר עֲלֵיהֶם בַּדָּרֶךְ וַיֻּגַּד לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: So the landowners of Shekhem set up ambushers against him on the summits of the mountains,and they robbed all those who were crossing them on the road.And it was told to Avimelekh.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא גַּעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד וְאֶחָיו וַיַּעַבְרוּ בִּשְׁכֶם וַיִּבְטְחוּ־בוֹ בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם׃
verses.english: Then Gaal/Loathing son of Eved/Slave came, along with his brothers,and they crossed through Shekhem.And the landowners of Shekhem put [their] trust in him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצְאוּ הַשָּׂדֶה וַיִּבְצְרוּ אֶת־כַּרְמֵיהֶם וַיִּדְרְכוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ הִלּוּלִים וַיָּבֹאוּ בֵּית אֱ‍לֹהֵיהֶם וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׁתּוּ וַיְקַלְלוּ אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: So they went out into the open-field, amassed their vineyards’ [grapes], and trod [them] out,and they made jubilation;then they entered the temple-house of their god, and ate and drank,and made light of Avimelekh.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר גַּעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד מִי־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וּמִי־שְׁכֶם כִּי נַעַבְדֶנּוּ הֲלֹא בֶן־יְרֻבַּעַל וּזְבֻל פְּקִידוֹ עִבְדוּ אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי חֲמוֹר אֲבִי שְׁכֶם וּמַדּוּעַ נַעַבְדֶנּוּ אֲנָחְנוּ׃
verses.english: Gaal son of Eved said:Who is Avimelekh, and who is Shekhem, that we should serve him?Is he not the son of Yerub-baal, and Zevul is his adjutant?The men of Hamor, Shekhem’s father, should serve him,but why should we serve him ourselves?

verses.hebrew: וּמִי יִתֵּן אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה בְּיָדִי וְאָסִירָה אֶת־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ רַבֶּה צְבָאֲךָ וָצֵאָה׃
verses.english: O who would give this people into my hand, that I might remove Avimelekh,that someone would say to Avimelekh:Drive off your forces and go away!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע זְבֻל שַׂר־הָעִיר אֶת־דִּבְרֵי גַּעַל בֶּן־עָבֶד וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ׃
verses.english: But Zevul the commander of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Eved,and his anger flared up,

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בְּתָרְמָה לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה גַעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד וְאֶחָיו בָּאִים שְׁכֶמָה וְהִנָּם צָרִים אֶת־הָעִיר עָלֶיךָ׃
verses.english: so he sent messengers to Avimelekh at Aruma, saying:Here, Gaal son of Eved and his brothers have come to Shekhem,and here, they are besieging the town against you!

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה קוּם לַיְלָה אַתָּה וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתָּךְ וֶאֱרֹב בַּשָּׂדֶה׃
verses.english: So-now, arise at night,you and the fighting-people who are with you,and wait in ambush in the open-country;

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַבֹּקֶר כִּזְרֹחַ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ תַּשְׁכִּים וּפָשַׁטְתָּ עַל־הָעִיר וְהִנֵּה־הוּא וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ יֹצְאִים אֵלֶיךָ וְעָשִׂיתָ לּוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר תִּמְצָא יָדֶךָ׃
verses.english: and it will be in the morning, when the sun rises:start-early and spread out against the city,and here, [when] he and the fighting-people who are with him go out to you,you may do with him whatever your hand finds.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ לָיְלָה וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ עַל־שְׁכֶם אַרְבָּעָה רָאשִׁים׃
verses.english: So Avimelekh arose, and all the fighting-people who were with him, at night;they lay in ambush against Shekhem, in four companies.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא גַּעַל בֶּן־עֶבֶד וַיַּעֲמֹד פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וַיָּקָם אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְהָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ מִן־הַמַּאְרָב׃
verses.english: Gaal son of Eved went out and stood at the entrance to the town gate,and Avimelekh and all the people who were with him arose from the ambush.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא־גַּעַל אֶת־הָעָם וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־זְבֻל הִנֵּה־עָם יוֹרֵד מֵרָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו זְבֻל אֵת צֵל הֶהָרִים אַתָּה רֹאֶה כָּאֲנָשִׁים׃
verses.english: Gaal saw the people, and he said to Zevul:Here, fighting-people are coming down from the mountains!Zevul said to him:It is the shadow of the mountains that you see as men!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף עוֹד גַּעַל לְדַבֵּר וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה־עָם יוֹרְדִים מֵעִם טַבּוּר הָאָרֶץ וְרֹאשׁ־אֶחָד בָּא מִדֶּרֶךְ אֵלוֹן מְעוֹנְנִים׃
verses.english: But Gaal continued further to speak and said:Here, fighting-people are coming down from the Navel of the Land,and one company is coming by way of the Soothsayers’ Oak!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו זְבֻל אַיֵּה אֵפוֹא פִיךָ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַר מִי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי נַעַבְדֶנּוּ הֲלֹא זֶה הָעָם אֲשֶׁר מָאַסְתָּה בּוֹ צֵא־נָא עַתָּה וְהִלָּחֶם בּוֹ׃
verses.english: Zevul said to him:Where, now, is your mouth that was saying:Who is Avimelekh, that we should serve him?Isn’t this the people whom you rejected?Pray go out now and wage battle against them!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא גַעַל לִפְנֵי בַּעֲלֵי שְׁכֶם וַיִּלָּחֶם בַּאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: So Gaal went out before the landowners of Shekhemand waged battle against Avimelekh.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדְּפֵהוּ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיָּנָס מִפָּנָיו וַיִּפְּלוּ חֲלָלִים רַבִּים עַד־פֶּתַח הַשָּׁעַר׃
verses.english: And Avimelekh pursued him, so that he fled from his face,and many wounded fell, up to the entrance of the gate.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בָּארוּמָה וַיְגָרֶשׁ זְבֻל אֶת־גַּעַל וְאֶת־אֶחָיו מִשֶּׁבֶת בִּשְׁכֶם׃
verses.english: Avimelekh stayed in Aruma,and Zevul drove out Gaal and his brothers from being settled in Shekhem.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִמָּחֳרָת וַיֵּצֵא הָעָם הַשָּׂדֶה וַיַּגִּדוּ לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ׃
verses.english: Now it was on the morrowthat the people went out to the open-country and told Avimelekh.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־הָעָם וַיֶּחֱצֵם לִשְׁלֹשָׁה רָאשִׁים וַיֶּאֱרֹב בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה הָעָם יֹצֵא מִן־הָעִיר וַיָּקָם עֲלֵיהֶם וַיַּכֵּם׃
verses.english: So he took the fighting-people and split them into three companiesand waited in ambush in the open-country.And he saw that here, the fighting-people were going out of the town,so he arose against them and struck them.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ וְהָרָאשִׁים אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ פָּשְׁטוּ וַיַּעַמְדוּ פֶּתַח שַׁעַר הָעִיר וּשְׁנֵי הָרָאשִׁים פָּשְׁטוּ עַל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיַּכּוּם׃
verses.english: Now Avimelekh and the companies that were with him spread outand took their stand at the entrance to the town gate,while the two [other] companies spread out against all those who were in the open-country, and struck them.

verses.hebrew: וַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ נִלְחָם בָּעִיר כֹּל הַיּוֹם הַהוּא וַיִּלְכֹּד אֶת־הָעִיר וְאֶת־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־בָּהּ הָרָג וַיִּתֹּץ אֶת־הָעִיר וַיִּזְרָעֶהָ מֶלַח׃
verses.english: Avimelekh was waging battle against the town all that day,and he captured the town,and all the people who were in it, he killed;then he demolished the town, and sowed it with salt.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ כָּל־בַּעֲלֵי מִגְדַּל־שְׁכֶם וַיָּבֹאוּ אֶל־צְרִיחַ בֵּית אֵל בְּרִית׃
verses.english: And all the landowners of the Tower of Shekhem heard,so they came to the underground-chamber of the Temple-House of El-Berit.

verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לַאֲבִימֶלֶךְ כִּי הִתְקַבְּצוּ כָּל־בַּעֲלֵי מִגְדַּל־שְׁכֶם׃
verses.english: And it was told to Avimelekh that all the landowners of the Tower of Shekhem had gathered,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל אֲבִימֶלֶךְ הַר־צַלְמוֹן הוּא וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־אִתּוֹ וַיִּקַּח אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶת־הַקַּרְדֻּמּוֹת בְּיָדוֹ וַיִּכְרֹת שׂוֹכַת עֵצִים וַיִּשָּׂאֶהָ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־שִׁכְמוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ מָה רְאִיתֶם עָשִׂיתִי מַהֲרוּ עֲשׂוּ כָמוֹנִי׃
verses.english: so Avimelekh went up the Mount of Tzalmon,he and all the fighting-people who were with him,and Avimelekh took axes in his handand cut down tree branch-clumps;he lifted them up, put them on his shoulderand said to the fighting-people who were with him:What you see me do—quickly, do like me!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּכְרְתוּ גַם־כָּל־הָעָם אִישׁ שׂוֹכֹה וַיֵּלְכוּ אַחֲרֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיָּשִׂימוּ עַל־הַצְּרִיחַ וַיַּצִּיתוּ עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־הַצְּרִיחַ בָּאֵשׁ וַיָּמֻתוּ גַּם כָּל־אַנְשֵׁי מִגְדַּל־שְׁכֶם כְּאֶלֶף אִישׁ וְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: So all the fighting-people also cut down, each one, a branch,and they went [following] after Avimelekh;they put them on the underground-chamber and kindled the cavern over them with fire,so that also all the men of the Tower of Shekhem died, about a thousand men and women.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֶל־תֵּבֵץ וַיִּחַן בְּתֵבֵץ וַיִּלְכְּדָהּ׃
verses.english: Avimelekh went to Tevetzand encamped against Tevetz, that he might capture it.

verses.hebrew: וּמִגְדַּל־עֹז הָיָה בְתוֹךְ־הָעִיר וַיָּנֻסוּ שָׁמָּה כָּל־הָאֲנָשִׁים וְהַנָּשִׁים וְכֹל בַּעֲלֵי הָעִיר וַיִּסְגְּרוּ בַּעֲדָם וַיַּעֲלוּ עַל־גַּג הַמִּגְדָּל׃
verses.english: Now there was a strong tower in the midst of the town,and they fled there, all the men and women, that is, all the landowners of the town;they shut it upon themselvesand went up on the roof of the tower.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֲבִימֶלֶךְ עַד־הַמִּגְדָּל וַיִּלָּחֶם בּוֹ וַיִּגַּשׁ עַד־פֶּתַח הַמִּגְדָּל לְשָׂרְפוֹ בָאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: And Avimelekh came up to the tower and waged battle against it,but when he approached the entrance of the tower to burn it with fire,

verses.hebrew: וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ אִשָּׁה אַחַת פֶּלַח רֶכֶב עַל־רֹאשׁ אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַתָּרִץ אֶת־גֻּלְגָּלְתּוֹ׃
verses.english: a woman threw a riding millstone onto Avimelekh’s headand crushed his skull.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא מְהֵרָה אֶל־הַנַּעַר נֹשֵׂא כֵלָיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ שְׁלֹף חַרְבְּךָ וּמוֹתְתֵנִי פֶּן־יֹאמְרוּ לִי אִשָּׁה הֲרָגָתְהוּ וַיִּדְקְרֵהוּ נַעֲרוֹ וַיָּמֹת׃
verses.english: Quickly he called out to his serving-lad, his weapons bearer,and said to him:Draw your sword and dispatch “die,” meaning “deal the death blow.” me,lest they say of me: A woman killed him!So his serving-lad pierced him through, and he died.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אִישׁ־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי מֵת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיֵּלְכוּ אִישׁ לִמְקֹמוֹ׃
verses.english: When the fighting-men of Israel saw that Avimelekh was dead,they went [home], each one to his place.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב אֱלֹהִים אֵת רָעַת אֲבִימֶלֶךְ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְאָבִיו לַהֲרֹג אֶת־שִׁבְעִים אֶחָיו׃
verses.english: Thus God returned the evil of Avimelekhthat he had done to his father, by killing his seventy brothers,

verses.hebrew: וְאֵת כָּל־רָעַת אַנְשֵׁי שְׁכֶם הֵשִׁיב אֱלֹהִים בְּרֹאשָׁם וַתָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם קִלֲלַת יוֹתָם בֶּן־יְרֻבָּעַל׃
verses.english: while all the evil of the men of Shekhem, God returned on their heads,and the curse of Yotam son of Yerub-baal came upon them.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם אַחֲרֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל תּוֹלָע בֶּן־פּוּאָה בֶּן־דּוֹדוֹ אִישׁ יִשָּׂשכָר וְהוּא־יֹשֵׁב בְּשָׁמִיר בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם׃
verses.english: There arose after Avimelekh, to deliver Israel,Tola/Scarlet son of Pua son of Dodo Meaning “uncle” or “beloved” (like the name “David”), it has an unfortunate ring in English. Hebrew, happily, places the accent on the last syllable., a man of Yissakhar.Now he was settled in Shamir, in the highlands of Efrayim.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וְשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁנָה וַיָּמָת וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּשָׁמִיר׃
verses.english: He led Israel as judge for twenty-three years;then he died, and was buried in Shamir.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם אַחֲרָיו יָאִיר הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: There arose after him Ya’ir the Gil’adite;he led Israel as judge for twenty-two years.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנִים רֹכְבִים עַל־שְׁלֹשִׁים עֲיָרִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים עֲיָרִים לָהֶם לָהֶם יִקְרְאוּ חַוֺּת יָאִיר עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ הַגִּלְעָד׃
verses.english: He had thirty sons riding on thirty foals,and they had thirty towns (towns) rather than ’ayarim. JPS nicely renders them “burros … boroughs.” The listing of possessions here undoubtedly stresses wealth; not all of these leaders are simple men of the people.;those they call the Tent-Villages of Ya’ir until this day, that are in the land of Gil’ad.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת יָאִיר וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּקָמוֹן׃
verses.english: Then Ya’ir died, and was buried in Kamon.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים וְאֶת־הָעַשְׁתָּרוֹת וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵי אֲרָם וְאֶת־אֱלֹהֵי צִידוֹן וְאֵת אֱלֹהֵי מוֹאָב וְאֵת אֱלֹהֵי בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וְאֵת אֱלֹהֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעַזְבוּ אֶת־יְהוָה וְלֹא עֲבָדוּהוּ׃
verses.english: But the Children of Israel continued doing what was evil in the eyes of YHWH;they served the Baals and the Astartesand the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moav,the gods of the Children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines;they abandoned YHWH, and did not serve him.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּמְכְּרֵם בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבְיַד בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: So YHWH’s anger flared up against the Children of Israel,and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the Children of Ammon;

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְעֲצוּ וַיְרֹצְצוּ אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁנָה הַהִיא שְׁמֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה אֶת־כָּל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן בְּאֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי אֲשֶׁר בַּגִּלְעָד׃
verses.english: they shattered and battered the Children of Israel from that year on for eighteen years—all the Children of Israel who were across the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gil’ad.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּן לְהִלָּחֵם גַּם־בִּיהוּדָה וּבְבִנְיָמִין וּבְבֵית אֶפְרָיִם וַתֵּצֶר לְיִשְׂרָאֵל מְאֹד׃
verses.english: And the Children of Ammon crossed the Jordan to wage battle also against Yehuda, and against Binyamin, and against the House of Efrayim,and Israel was exceedingly distressed.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה לֵאמֹר חָטָאנוּ לָךְ וְכִי עָזַבְנוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנַּעֲבֹד אֶת־הַבְּעָלִים׃
verses.english: So Israel cried out to YHWH, saying:We have sinned against you!For we have abandoned our Godand have served the Baals!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלֹא מִמִּצְרַיִם וּמִן־הָאֱמֹרִי וּמִן־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וּמִן־פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: YHWH said to the Children of Israel:Did not [I deliver you] from Egypt and from the Amorites and from the Children of Ammon and from the Philistines?

verses.hebrew: וְצִידוֹנִים וַעֲמָלֵק וּמָעוֹן לָחֲצוּ אֶתְכֶם וַתִּצְעֲקוּ אֵלַי וָאוֹשִׁיעָה אֶתְכֶם מִיָּדָם׃
verses.english: And when the Sidonians and Amalek and Midyan oppressed you,you cried out to me,and I delivered you from their hand;

verses.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם עֲזַבְתֶּם אוֹתִי וַתַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים לָכֵן לֹא־אוֹסִיף לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם׃
verses.english: but you have abandoned me, and served other gods—therefore I will not continue to deliver you.

verses.hebrew: לְכוּ וְזַעֲקוּ אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בְּחַרְתֶּם בָּם הֵמָּה יוֹשִׁיעוּ לָכֶם בְּעֵת צָרַתְכֶם׃
verses.english: Go cry out to the gods whom you have chosen,let them deliver you at the time of your distress!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה חָטָאנוּ עֲשֵׂה־אַתָּה לָנוּ כְּכָל־הַטּוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ אַךְ הַצִּילֵנוּ נָא הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: The Children of Israel said to YHWH:We have sinned!Do, you yourself, to usaccording with whatever is good in your eyes,only: just rescue us this day!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּסִירוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר מִקִּרְבָּם וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ בַּעֲמַל יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: So they removed the foreign gods from their midstand served YHWH,and he became short-tempered with the travails of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּעֲקוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּגִּלְעָד וַיֵּאָסְפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּחֲנוּ בַּמִּצְפָּה׃
verses.english: The Children of Ammon mustered [troops] and encamped in Gil’ad,while the Children of Israel gathered and encamped in Mitzpa.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הָעָם שָׂרֵי גִלְעָד אִישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵהוּ מִי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יָחֵל לְהִלָּחֵם בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן יִהְיֶה לְרֹאשׁ לְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי גִלְעָד׃
verses.english: The fighting-people, the commanders of Gil’ad, said each one to his fellow:Who is the man that will be first to do battle against the Children of Ammon?He shall be head of all the settled-folk of Gil’ad!

verses.hebrew: וְיִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי הָיָה גִּבּוֹר חַיִל וְהוּא בֶּן־אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיּוֹלֶד גִּלְעָד אֶת־יִפְתָּח׃
verses.english: Now Yiftah trad. English “Jephthah.” Ironically for the story of a father and a daughter, with no mother mentioned, the name denotes God “opening” the womb. the Gil’adite was a mighty-man of valor,but he was the son of a whore woman;Gil’ad begot Yiftah.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד אֵשֶׁת־גִּלְעָד לוֹ בָּנִים וַיִּגְדְּלוּ בְנֵי־הָאִשָּׁה וַיְגָרְשׁוּ אֶת־יִפְתָּח וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֹא־תִנְחַל בְּבֵית־אָבִינוּ כִּי בֶּן־אִשָּׁה אַחֶרֶת אָתָּה׃
verses.english: And Gil’ad’s wife bore him sons,but when the wife’s sons grew up,they drove Yiftah away and said to him:You shall not get hereditary-property in our Father’s House,for you are the son of a different woman!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח יִפְתָּח מִפְּנֵי אֶחָיו וַיֵּשֶׁב בְּאֶרֶץ טוֹב וַיִּתְלַקְּטוּ אֶל־יִפְתָּח אֲנָשִׁים רֵיקִים וַיֵּצְאוּ עִמּוֹ׃
verses.english: So Yiftah ran away from the face of his brothersand settled in the land of Tov/Good.And there gathered around Yiftah empty men;they went out [to war] beside him.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים וַיִּלָּחֲמוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now it was after some yearsthat the Children of Ammon did battle with Israel,

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־נִלְחֲמוּ בְנֵי־עַמּוֹן עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּלְכוּ זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד לָקַחַת אֶת־יִפְתָּח מֵאֶרֶץ טוֹב׃
verses.english: and it was, when the Children of Ammon did battle with Israelthat the elders of Gil’ad went to fetch Yiftah from the land of Tov.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְיִפְתָּח לְכָה וְהָיִיתָה לָּנוּ לְקָצִין וְנִלָּחֲמָה בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: They said to Yiftah:Come now and become chief an Arabic cognate means “one who renders judgment”—hence, parallel to “judge” (shofet), another leadership title. for us,that we may wage battle against the Children of Ammon!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִפְתָּח לְזִקְנֵי גִלְעָד הֲלֹא אַתֶּם שְׂנֵאתֶם אוֹתִי וַתְּגָרְשׁוּנִי מִבֵּית אָבִי וּמַדּוּעַ בָּאתֶם אֵלַי עַתָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר צַר לָכֶם׃
verses.english: Yiftah said to the elders of Gil’ad:Is it not you who spurned meand drove me away from my Father’s House?So for-what-reason have you come to me now,when you are in distress?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד אֶל־יִפְתָּח לָכֵן עַתָּה שַׁבְנוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְהָלַכְתָּ עִמָּנוּ וְנִלְחַמְתָּ בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן וְהָיִיתָ לָּנוּ לְרֹאשׁ לְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי גִלְעָד׃
verses.english: The elders of Gil’ad said to Yiftah:Agreed, [but] now we have returned to you, so that you may go with usand wage battle against the Children of Ammon,that you may be headman for us,for all the settled-folk of Gil’ad!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִפְתָּח אֶל־זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד אִם־מְשִׁיבִים אַתֶּם אוֹתִי לְהִלָּחֵם בִּבְנֵי עַמּוֹן וְנָתַן יְהוָה אוֹתָם לְפָנָי אָנֹכִי אֶהְיֶה לָכֶם לְרֹאשׁ׃
verses.english: Yiftah said to the elders of Gil’ad:If you reinstate me, yourselves, to wage battle against the Children of Ammon,so that YHWH gives them before me,I will be headman for you.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ זִקְנֵי־גִלְעָד אֶל־יִפְתָּח יְהוָה יִהְיֶה שֹׁמֵעַ בֵּינוֹתֵינוּ אִם־לֹא כִדְבָרְךָ כֵּן נַעֲשֶׂה׃
verses.english: The elders of Gil’ad said to Yiftah:May YHWH be hearer between us:if we do not do so, in accordance with your word … !

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ יִפְתָּח עִם־זִקְנֵי גִלְעָד וַיָּשִׂימוּ הָעָם אוֹתוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם לְרֹאשׁ וּלְקָצִין וַיְדַבֵּר יִפְתָּח אֶת־כָּל־דְּבָרָיו לִפְנֵי יְהוָה בַּמִּצְפָּה׃
verses.english: So Yiftah went with the elders of Gil’ad,and the people set him as headman and as chief over them;and Yiftah spoke all his terms in the presence of YHWH at Mitzpa.[I deliver you]: Implied by the somewhat corrupt Hebrew text. the Children of Ammon … the Philistines: The historical subjugation of these peoples lay in the future, suggesting that these lines are a later addition.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִפְתָּח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן לֵאמֹר מַה־לִּי וָלָךְ כִּי־בָאתָ אֵלַי לְהִלָּחֵם בְּאַרְצִי׃
verses.english: Then Yiftah sent messengers to the king of the Children of Ammon, saying:What is there [between] me and you,that you come to me, to wage battle against my land?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי־עַמּוֹן אֶל־מַלְאֲכֵי יִפְתָּח כִּי־לָקַח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אַרְצִי בַּעֲלוֹתוֹ מִמִּצְרַיִם מֵאַרְנוֹן וְעַד־הַיַּבֹּק וְעַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן וְעַתָּה הָשִׁיבָה אֶתְהֶן בְּשָׁלוֹם׃
verses.english: The king of the Children of Ammon said to Yiftah’s messengers:Because Israel took away my land when they came up from Egypt,from the Arnon as far as the Yabbok is trad. English “Jabbok.” , as far as the Jordan.So-now, return it peaceably!

verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹסֶף עוֹד יִפְתָּח וַיִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים אֶל־מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: Yiftah once again sent messengers to the king of the Children of Ammon;

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ כֹּה אָמַר יִפְתָּח לֹא־לָקַח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־אֶרֶץ מוֹאָב וְאֶת־אֶרֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: he said to him:Thus says Yiftah:Israel did not take away the land of Moav or the land of the Children of Ammon;

verses.hebrew: כִּי בַּעֲלוֹתָם מִמִּצְרָיִם וַיֵּלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּמִּדְבָּר עַד־יַם־סוּף וַיָּבֹא קָדֵשָׁה׃
verses.english: rather, when they came up from Egypt,Israel went through the wilderness, near the Sea of Reeds, and came to Kadesh.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־מֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם לֵאמֹר אֶעְבְּרָה־נָּא בְאַרְצֶךָ וְלֹא שָׁמַע מֶלֶךְ אֱדוֹם וְגַם אֶל־מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב שָׁלַח וְלֹא אָבָה וַיֵּשֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּקָדֵשׁ׃
verses.english: And Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying:Now let me cross through your land.But the king of Edom did not hearken,and they sent also to the king of Moav, but he was not willing,so Israel stayed at Kadesh.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיָּסָב אֶת־אֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם וְאֶת־אֶרֶץ מוֹאָב וַיָּבֹא מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ לְאֶרֶץ מוֹאָב וַיַּחֲנוּן בְּעֵבֶר אַרְנוֹן וְלֹא־בָאוּ בִּגְבוּל מוֹאָב כִּי אַרְנוֹן גְּבוּל מוֹאָב׃
verses.english: Then they went through the wilderness and circled around the land of Edom and the land of Moav,and they came to the sun-rise [side] of the land of Moav, and encamped across the Arnon,but they did not come into the territory of Moav,for the Arnon is the territory-border of Moav.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְאָכִים אֶל־סִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ־הָאֱמֹרִי מֶלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּוֹן וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל נַעְבְּרָה־נָּא בְאַרְצְךָ עַד־מְקוֹמִי׃
verses.english: And Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, king of Heshbon;Israel said to him:Now let me cross through your land, to my place.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־הֶאֱמִין סִיחוֹן אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבֹר בִּגְבֻלוֹ וַיֶּאֱסֹף סִיחוֹן אֶת־כָּל־עַמּוֹ וַיַּחֲנוּ בְּיָהְצָה וַיִּלָּחֶם עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: But Sihon did not trust Israel to cross through his territory;Sihon gathered all his fighting-people and encamped at Yahatz,and did battle with Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־סִיחוֹן וְאֶת־כָּל־עַמּוֹ בְּיַד יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיַּכּוּם וַיִּירַשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵת כָּל־אֶרֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי יוֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ הַהִיא׃
verses.english: But YHWH the God of Israel gave Sihon and all his fighting-people into the hand of Israel, and they struck them,so Israel came to possess the entire land of the Amorites, the settled-folk of that land.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּירְשׁוּ אֵת כָּל־גְּבוּל הָאֱמֹרִי מֵאַרְנוֹן וְעַד־הַיַּבֹּק וּמִן־הַמִּדְבָּר וְעַד־הַיַּרְדֵּן׃
verses.english: They took possession of the entire territory of the Amorites,from the Arnon as far as the Yabbok and from the wilderness as far as the Jordan.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוֹרִישׁ אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי מִפְּנֵי עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַתָּה תִּירָשֶׁנּוּ׃
verses.english: So-now,YHWH the God of Israel dispossessed the Amorites before his people Israel—and you, you would take possession of it?

verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא אֵת אֲשֶׁר יוֹרִישְׁךָ כְּמוֹשׁ אֱלֹהֶיךָ אוֹתוֹ תִירָשׁ וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִישׁ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מִפָּנֵינוּ אוֹתוֹ נִירָשׁ׃
verses.english: Is it not: what Kemosh your god dispossesses, of that you may take possession,and whatever YHWH our God dispossesses before us, of that we may take possession?

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הֲטוֹב טוֹב אַתָּה מִבָּלָק בֶּן־צִפּוֹר מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב הֲרוֹב רָב עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם־נִלְחֹם נִלְחַם בָּם׃
verses.english: So-now, are you better, yes, better than Balak he appears more famously in the Bil’am (Balaam) story of Num. 22–24. son of Tzippor, king of Moav?Did he strive, yes, strive with Israel,or wage battle, yes, battle against them?

verses.hebrew: בְּשֶׁבֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּחֶשְׁבּוֹן וּבִבְנוֹתֶיהָ וּבְעַרְעוֹר וּבִבְנוֹתֶיהָ וּבְכָל־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־יְדֵי אַרְנוֹן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה וּמַדּוּעַ לֹא־הִצַּלְתֶּם בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃
verses.english: When Israel remained-settled in Heshbon and its daughter-towns, and in Ar’or and its daughter-towns,and in all the towns that are along the Arnon,for three hundred years,for-what-reason did you not rescue [them] during that time?

verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי לֹא־חָטָאתִי לָךְ וְאַתָּה עֹשֶׂה אִתִּי רָעָה לְהִלָּחֶם בִּי יִשְׁפֹּט יְהוָה הַשֹּׁפֵט הַיּוֹם בֵּין בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: As for me, I have not sinned against you,yet you do me evil by waging battle against me!May YHWH the judge render judgment today between Israel and the Children of Ammon!

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמַע מֶלֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן אֶל־דִּבְרֵי יִפְתָּח אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח אֵלָיו׃
verses.english: But the king of the Children of Ammon did not hearken to Yiftah’s words which he had sent to him.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי עַל־יִפְתָּח רוּחַ יְהוָה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־הַגִּלְעָד וְאֶת־מְנַשֶּׁה וַיַּעֲבֹר אֶת־מִצְפֵּה גִלְעָד וּמִמִּצְפֵּה גִלְעָד עָבַר בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: Now there came upon Yiftah the rushing-spirit of YHWH;he crossed over to Gil’ad and Menashe,and he crossed over to Mitzpe of Gil’ad, and from Mitzpe of Gil’ad he crossed over to the Children of Ammon.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּדַּר יִפְתָּח נֶדֶר לַיהוָה וַיֹּאמַר אִם־נָתוֹן תִּתֵּן אֶת־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן בְּיָדִי׃
verses.english: And Yiftah vowed a vow to YHWH and said:If you will give, yes, give the Children of Ammon into my hand,

verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הַיּוֹצֵא אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִדַּלְתֵי בֵיתִי לִקְרָאתִי בְּשׁוּבִי בְשָׁלוֹם מִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וְהָיָה לַיהוָה וְהַעֲלִיתִהוּ עוֹלָה׃
verses.english: it will be: the one going out who goes out of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the Children of Ammonshall be YHWH’sand shall be offered up by me as an offering-up!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר יִפְתָּח אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן לְהִלָּחֶם בָּם וַיִתְּנֵם יְהוָה בְּיָדוֹ׃
verses.english: So Yiftah crossed over to the Children of Ammon, to wage battle against them,and YHWH gave them into his hand;

verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּם מֵעֲרוֹעֵר וְעַד־בּוֹאֲךָ מִנִּית עֶשְׂרִים עִיר וְעַד אָבֵל כְּרָמִים מַכָּה גְּדוֹלָה מְאֹד וַיִּכָּנְעוּ בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן מִפְּנֵי בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: he struck them from Aro’er as far as where-you-come to Minnit,twenty towns, and as far as Avel-Keramim,an exceedingly great striking down,and the Children of Ammon were humbled before the Children of Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יִפְתָּח הַמִּצְפָּה אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְהִנֵּה בִתּוֹ יֹצֵאת לִקְרָאתוֹ בְתֻפִּים וּבִמְחֹלוֹת וְרַק הִיא יְחִידָה אֵין־לוֹ מִמֶּנּוּ בֵּן אוֹ־בַת׃
verses.english: Yiftah came back to Mitzpa, to his house,and here, his daughter was going out to meet him, with timbrels and with dancing—yet she was a lone-child, he had no son or daughter beside her.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִרְאוֹתוֹ אוֹתָהּ וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֲהָהּ בִּתִּי הַכְרֵעַ הִכְרַעְתִּנִי וְאַתְּ הָיִיתְ בְּעֹכְרָי וְאָנֹכִי פָּצִיתִי־פִי אֶל־יְהוָה וְלֹא אוּכַל לָשׁוּב׃
verses.english: It was, when he saw her,that he tore his garmentsand said:Alas, my daughter! You have cast, yes, cast me down) are an anagram of ’okhri, “my disaster,” recalling the Akhan story in Josh. 7. Consequently the LXX emends the first phrase accordingly: “You have brought disaster …” ,you have become my disaster—for I myself opened my mouth to YHWH,and I am not able to turn it back!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אָבִי פָּצִיתָה אֶת־פִּיךָ אֶל־יְהוָה עֲשֵׂה לִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצָא מִפִּיךָ אַחֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְךָ יְהוָה נְקָמוֹת מֵאֹיְבֶיךָ מִבְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃
verses.english: She said to him:Father, you opened your mouth to YHWH;do with me as has gone out of your mouth,since YHWH has wrought for you acts of vengeance against your enemies, from the Children of Ammon!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֶל־אָבִיהָ יֵעָשֶׂה לִּי הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה הַרְפֵּה מִמֶּנִּי שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים וְאֵלְכָה וְיָרַדְתִּי עַל־הֶהָרִים וְאֶבְכֶּה עַל־בְּתוּלַי אָנֹכִי ורעיתי [וְרֵעוֹתָי׃]
verses.english: And she said to her father:Let this thing be done for me:let me be for two months,so that I may go down for MT ve-yaradti. But see JPS on Isa. 15:3, where y-r-d and weeping occur together. upon the highlandsand weep for my womanhood, I and my companions.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֵכִי וַיִּשְׁלַח אוֹתָהּ שְׁנֵי חֳדָשִׁים וַתֵּלֶךְ הִיא וְרֵעוֹתֶיהָ וַתֵּבְךְּ עַל־בְּתוּלֶיהָ עַל־הֶהָרִים׃
verses.english: He said:Go.He sent her off for two months,and she went, she and her companions,and wept for her womanhood upon the hills.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁנַיִם חֳדָשִׁים וַתָּשָׁב אֶל־אָבִיהָ וַיַּעַשׂ לָהּ אֶת־נִדְרוֹ אֲשֶׁר נָדָר וְהִיא לֹא־יָדְעָה אִישׁ וַתְּהִי־חֹק בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: It was at the end of two monthsthat she returned to her father,and he wrought upon her his vow that he had vowed.Now she had never known a man.And it became a rule in Israel:

verses.hebrew: מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה תֵּלַכְנָה בְּנוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל לְתַנּוֹת לְבַת־יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי אַרְבַּעַת יָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה׃
verses.english: from year-day to year-day, the daughters of Israel go toretell [the tale] of the daughter of Yiftah the Gil’adite,four days a year.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצָּעֵק אִישׁ אֶפְרַיִם וַיַּעֲבֹר צָפוֹנָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְיִפְתָּח מַדּוּעַ עָבַרְתָּ לְהִלָּחֵם בִּבְנֵי־עַמּוֹן וְלָנוּ לֹא קָרָאתָ לָלֶכֶת עִמָּךְ בֵּיתְךָ נִשְׂרֹף עָלֶיךָ בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: The men of Efrayim were mustered;they crossed over to Tzafonand said to Yiftah:For-what-reason did you cross over to wage battle against the Children of Ammon,but us you did not call to go with you?Your house we will burn down over you with fire!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִפְתָּח אֲלֵיהֶם אִישׁ רִיב הָיִיתִי אֲנִי וְעַמִּי וּבְנֵי־עַמּוֹן מְאֹד וָאֶזְעַק אֶתְכֶם וְלֹא־הוֹשַׁעְתֶּם אוֹתִי מִיָּדָם׃
verses.english: Yiftah said to them:I was a man here connoting diplomacy, not warfare. in strife, I and my people and the Children of Ammon, exceedingly much;I summoned you, but you did not deliver me from their hand,

verses.hebrew: וָאֶרְאֶה כִּי־אֵינְךָ מוֹשִׁיע וָאָשִׂימָה נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי וָאֶעְבְּרָה אֶל־בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהוָה בְּיָדִי וְלָמָה עֲלִיתֶם אֵלַי הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְהִלָּחֶם בִּי׃
verses.english: so when I saw that you were not acting-as-deliverer,I put my life in my palm and crossed over to the Children of Ammon,and YHWH gave them into my hand.So why have you come up against me this day, to wage battle against me?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ יִפְתָּח אֶת־כָּל־אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד וַיִּלָּחֶם אֶת־אֶפְרָיִם וַיַּכּוּ אַנְשֵׁי גִלְעָד אֶת־אֶפְרַיִם כִּי אָמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אַתֶּם גִּלְעָד בְּתוֹךְ אֶפְרַיִם בְּתוֹךְ מְנַשֶּׁה׃
verses.english: And Yiftah gathered all the fighting-men of Gil’ad and did battle with Efrayim,and the men of Gil’ad struck Efrayim,for they had said:Fugitives of Efrayim are you, [men of] Gil’ad;[being] among Efrayim is [like being] among Menashe!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּלְכֹּד גִּלְעָד אֶת־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן לְאֶפְרָיִם וְהָיָה כִּי יֹאמְרוּ פְּלִיטֵי אֶפְרַיִם אֶעֱבֹרָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי־גִלְעָד הַאֶפְרָתִי אַתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא׃
verses.english: And Gil’ad took the Jordan crossings of Efrayim.Now it would be, when [one of] the fugitives of Efrayim would say:Let me cross!that the men of Gil’ad would say to him:Are you an Efratite?He would say:No.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֱמָר־נָא שִׁבֹּלֶת וַיֹּאמֶר סִבֹּלֶת וְלֹא יָכִין לְדַבֵּר כֵּן וַיֹּאחֲזוּ אוֹתוֹ וַיִּשְׁחָטוּהוּ אֶל־מַעְבְּרוֹת הַיַּרְדֵּן וַיִּפֹּל בָּעֵת הַהִיא מֵאֶפְרַיִם אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנַיִם אָלֶף׃
verses.english: Then they would say to him:Now say “shibbolet,” The word, Heb. shee-BOH-let, means either “ear of grain” or “stream,” but that is less important than the pronunciation issue. Gray (1986) points to the differing Hebrew and Arabic pronunciations of one letter as a parallel (e.g., Heb. shalom and Arabic salaam). The word itself has entered English in the form “shibboleth,” meaning a password or test word. and he would say “sibbolet”—he did not understand) for MT yakhin (“prepare”). how to speak correctly—so they would grab him and slaughter him, at the Jordan crossings;there fell from Efrayim at that time forty-two thousand.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט יִפְתָּח אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים וַיָּמָת יִפְתָּח הַגִּלְעָדִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּעָרֵי גִלְעָד׃
verses.english: And Yiftah led Israel as judge for six years;then Yiftah the Gil’adite diedand was buried in his town, [in] Gil’ad.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אִבְצָן מִבֵּית לָחֶם׃
verses.english: After him, Ivtzan from Bet-Lehem usually denoting the familiar town (Bethlehem) just south of Jerusalem, but Boling suggests here another site far to the north, near Lebanon. led Israel as judge;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ שְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת שִׁלַּח הַחוּצָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בָּנוֹת הֵבִיא לְבָנָיו מִן־הַחוּץ וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: —he had thirty sons,and thirty daughters he sent away outside,while thirty daughters he brought for his sons from the outside—and he led Israel as judge for seven years.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת אִבְצָן וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּבֵית לָחֶם׃
verses.english: Then Ivtzan diedand was buried in Bet-Lehem.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵילוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: After him, Elon the Zevulonite led Israel as judge,and led Israel as judge for ten years.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת אֵלוֹן הַזְּבוּלֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּאַיָּלוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ זְבוּלֻן׃
verses.english: Then Elon the Zevulonite diedand was buried in Ayyalon, in the region of Zevulun.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אַחֲרָיו אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי׃
verses.english: After him, Avdon son of Hillel the Pir’atonite led Israel as judge

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי־לוֹ אַרְבָּעִים בָּנִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים בְּנֵי בָנִים רֹכְבִים עַל־שִׁבְעִים עֲיָרִם וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמֹנֶה שָׁנִים׃
verses.english: —he had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons, riding on seventy ass-colts—and led Israel as judge for eight years.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת עַבְדּוֹן בֶּן־הִלֵּל הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִי וַיִּקָּבֵר בְּפִרְעָתוֹן בְּאֶרֶץ אֶפְרַיִם בְּהַר הָעֲמָלֵקִי׃
verses.english: Then Avdon son of Hillel the Pir’atonite diedand was buried at Pir’aton in the region of Efrayim, in the Amalekite highlands.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסִפוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת הָרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיִּתְּנֵם יְהוָה בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: The Children of Israel again did what was evil in the eyes of YHWH,so YHWH gave them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אִישׁ אֶחָד מִצָּרְעָה מִמִּשְׁפַּחַת הַדָּנִי וּשְׁמוֹ מָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלָדָה׃
verses.english: There was a man from Tzor’a, from a Danite clan;his name was Manoah. the name connotes a “secure resting place.”Now his wife was barren, she had not given birth.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָה אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ הִנֵּה־נָא אַתְּ־עֲקָרָה וְלֹא יָלַדְתְּ וְהָרִית וְיָלַדְתְּ בֵּן׃
verses.english: And YHWH’s messenger was seen by the woman;he said to her:Now here,you are barren, you have not given birth,but you shall conceive, you shall give birth to a son.

verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה הִשָּׁמְרִי נָא וְאַל־תִּשְׁתִּי יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר וְאַל־תֹּאכְלִי כָּל־טָמֵא׃
verses.english: So-now, pray guard yourself:do not drink wine or beer,do not eat anything tamei, Ritually polluted, and so forbidden (see, for instance, the list in Lev. 11).

verses.hebrew: כִּי הִנָּךְ הָרָה וְיֹלַדְתְּ בֵּן וּמוֹרָה לֹא־יַעֲלֶה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים יִהְיֶה הַנַּעַר מִן־הַבָּטֶן וְהוּא יָחֵל לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִיַּד פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: for here, you are about to conceive, you shall give birth to a son.A razor must not go up on his head,for One Consecrated to God shall the lad be from the womb on;he shall begin to deliver Israel from the hand of the Philistines!

verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹא הָאִשָּׁה וַתֹּאמֶר לְאִישָׁהּ לֵאמֹר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים בָּא אֵלַי וּמַרְאֵהוּ כְּמַרְאֵה מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים נוֹרָא מְאֹד וְלֹא שְׁאִלְתִּיהוּ אֵי־מִזֶּה הוּא וְאֶת־שְׁמוֹ לֹא־הִגִּיד לִי׃
verses.english: The woman came and said to her husband, saying:A man of God came to me,the sight of him like the sight of a messenger of God,exceedingly awe-inspiring.I did not ask him where he was from,and his name he did not tell me,

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לִי הִנָּךְ הָרָה וְיֹלַדְתְּ בֵּן וְעַתָּה אַל־תִּשְׁתִּי יַיִן וְשֵׁכָר וְאַל־תֹּאכְלִי כָּל־טֻמְאָה כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים יִהְיֶה הַנַּעַר מִן־הַבֶּטֶן עַד־יוֹם מוֹתוֹ׃
verses.english: but he said to me:Here, you are about to conceive, you shall give birth to a son;so-now,do not drink wine or beer,do not eat anything tamei,for One Consecrated to God shall the lad befrom the womb until the day of his death!

verses.hebrew: וַיֶּעְתַּר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר בִּי אֲדוֹנָי אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַחְתָּ יָבוֹא־נָא עוֹד אֵלֵינוּ וְיוֹרֵנוּ מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה לַנַּעַר הַיּוּלָּד׃
verses.english: Manoah entreated YHWH, he said:O my Lord,as for the man of God whom you sent, pray let him come again to usand instruct us: What are we to do for the boy who will be born?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע הָאֱלֹהִים בְּקוֹל מָנוֹחַ וַיָּבֹא מַלְאַךְ הָאֱלֹהִים עוֹד אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת בַּשָּׂדֶה וּמָנוֹחַ אִישָׁהּ אֵין עִמָּהּ׃
verses.english: God hearkened to the voice of Manoah,and God’s messenger came again to the woman—now she was sitting in the open-field, while her husband Manoah was not with her.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּמַהֵר הָאִשָּׁה וַתָּרָץ וַתַּגֵּד לְאִישָׁהּ וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו הִנֵּה נִרְאָה אֵלַי הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בָּא בַיּוֹם אֵלָי׃
verses.english: Quickly the woman ran and told it to her husband; she said to him:Here, he has made himself seen by me, the man who came in the day to me!

verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם וַיֵּלֶךְ מָנוֹחַ אַחֲרֵי אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיָּבֹא אֶל־הָאִישׁ וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הַאַתָּה הָאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּרְתָּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיֹּאמֶר אָנִי׃
verses.english: Manoah arose and went after his wife;he came to the man and said to him:Are you the man who spoke to the woman?He said:I am.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ עַתָּה יָבֹא דְבָרֶיךָ מַה־יִּהְיֶה מִשְׁפַּט־הַנַּעַר וּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃
verses.english: Manoah said:So-now, should your words come to pass,what will be the rule for the boy and what-we-do for him?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־אָמַרְתִּי אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה תִּשָּׁמֵר׃
verses.english: YHWH’s messenger said to Manoah:From all that I said to the woman she is to guard herself,

verses.hebrew: מִכֹּל אֲשֶׁר־יֵצֵא מִגֶּפֶן הַיַּיִן לֹא תֹאכַל וְיַיִן וְשֵׁכָר אַל־תֵּשְׁתְּ וְכָל־טֻמְאָה אַל־תֹּאכַל כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־צִוִּיתִיהָ תִּשְׁמֹר׃
verses.english: from all that goes out from the vine of wine she is not to eat,wine and beer she must not drink,all [things] tamei she must not eat;all that I have commanded her, she is to guard.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה נַעְצְרָה־נָּא אוֹתָךְ וְנַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ גְּדִי עִזִּים׃
verses.english: Manoah said to YHWH’s messenger:Now let us detain you,that we may make ready a goats’ kid for you.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ אִם־תַּעְצְרֵנִי לֹא־אֹכַל בְּלַחְמֶךָ וְאִם־תַּעֲשֶׂה עֹלָה לַיהוָה תַּעֲלֶנָּה כִּי לֹא־יָדַע מָנוֹחַ כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה הוּא׃
verses.english: YHWH’s messenger said to Manoah:If you detain me, I will not eat of your food,but if you wish to make ready an offering-up to YHWH, you should offer it up—for Manoah did not know that he was YHWH’s messenger.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה מִי שְׁמֶךָ כִּי־יָבֹא דבריך [דְבָרְךָ] וְכִבַּדְנוּךָ׃
verses.english: Manoah said to YHWH’s messenger:What is your name,so that when your words come to pass, we may honor you?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לּוֹ מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה לָמָּה זֶּה תִּשְׁאַל לִשְׁמִי וְהוּא־פֶלִאי׃
verses.english: YHWH’s messenger said to him:Now why do you ask about my name?For it is wondrous!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח מָנוֹחַ אֶת־גְּדִי הָעִזִּים וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָה וַיַּעַל עַל־הַצּוּר לַיהוָה וּמַפְלִא לַעֲשׂוֹת וּמָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ רֹאִים׃
verses.english: Manoah took the goats’ kid and the gift-offeringand offered them up on the rock to YHWH.He did wondrously, while Manoah and his wife saw it:

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַעֲלוֹת הַלַּהַב מֵעַל הַמִּזְבֵּחַ הַשָּׁמַיְמָה וַיַּעַל מַלְאַךְ־יְהוָה בְּלַהַב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וּמָנוֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ רֹאִים וַיִּפְּלוּ עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם אָרְצָה׃
verses.english: it was,as the flame was going upward from the altar to the heavens,that YHWH’s messenger went up in the flame of the altar.When Manoah and his wife saw it,they flung themselves upon their faces to the ground.

verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יָסַף עוֹד מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה לְהֵרָאֹה אֶל־מָנוֹחַ וְאֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ אָז יָדַע מָנוֹחַ כִּי־מַלְאַךְ יְהוָה הוּא׃
verses.english: YHWH’s messenger was not seen again by Manoah or by his wife,so Manoah knew that he was YHWH’s messenger.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָנוֹחַ אֶל־אִשְׁתּוֹ מוֹת נָמוּת כִּי אֱלֹהִים רָאִינוּ׃
verses.english: Manoah said to his wife:We are going to die, yes, die,for it is a god that we have seen!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר לוֹ אִשְׁתּוֹ לוּ חָפֵץ יְהוָה לַהֲמִיתֵנוּ לֹא־לָקַח מִיָּדֵנוּ עֹלָה וּמִנְחָה וְלֹא הֶרְאָנוּ אֶת־כָּל־אֵלֶּה וְכָעֵת לֹא הִשְׁמִיעָנוּ כָּזֹאת׃
verses.english: But his wife said to him:Had YHWH desired to have us diehe would not have taken an offering-up and a grain-gift from our hand,he would not have let us see all these,and at that moment, he would not have let us hear such things.

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד הָאִשָּׁה בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּגְדַּל הַנַּעַר וַיְבָרְכֵהוּ יְהוָה׃
verses.english: The woman gave birth to a son;she called his name Shimshon.; trad. English “Samson.” See the discussion of the name in the essay “On the Shimshon Cycle,” above.The boy grew up, and YHWH blessed him.

verses.hebrew: וַתָּחֶל רוּחַ יְהוָה לְפַעֲמוֹ בְּמַחֲנֵה־דָן בֵּין צָרְעָה וּבֵין אֶשְׁתָּאֹל׃
verses.english: And YHWH’s rushing-spirit began to stir him up in Mahaneh-Dan,between Tzor’a and Eshtaol.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן תִּמְנָתָה וַיַּרְא אִשָּׁה בְּתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים׃
verses.english: Shimshon went down to Timna,and he saw a woman in Timna from the daughters of the Philistines.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל וַיַּגֵּד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אִשָּׁה רָאִיתִי בְתִמְנָתָה מִבְּנוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְעַתָּה קְחוּ־אוֹתָהּ לִּי לְאִשָּׁה׃
verses.english: He came up and told it to his father and to his mother;he said:A woman have I seen in Timna from the daughters of the Philistines.So-now, take her for me as a wife!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ הַאֵין בִּבְנוֹת אַחֶיךָ וּבְכָל־עַמִּי אִשָּׁה כִּי־אַתָּה הוֹלֵךְ לָקַחַת אִשָּׁה מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים הָעֲרֵלִים וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶל־אָבִיו אוֹתָהּ קַח־לִי כִּי־הִיא יָשְׁרָה בְעֵינָי׃
verses.english: His father and his mother said to him:Is there not among your brothers’ daughters or among all my people a woman,that you must go to take a woman from the Philistines, the Foreskinned Ones?Shimshon said to his father:Take her for me, for she is right in my eyes!

verses.hebrew: וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ לֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי מֵיְהוָה הִיא כִּי־תֹאֲנָה הוּא־מְבַקֵּשׁ מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים וּבָעֵת הַהִיא פְּלִשְׁתִּים מֹשְׁלִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
verses.english: Now his father and his mother did not know that it was from YHWH,for he was seeking a pretext from the Philistines—now at that time the Philistines were ruling over Israel.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְאָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ תִּמְנָתָה וַיָּבֹאוּ עַד־כַּרְמֵי תִמְנָתָה וְהִנֵּה כְּפִיר אֲרָיוֹת שֹׁאֵג לִקְרָאתוֹ׃
verses.english: Shimshon went down along with his father and his mother to Timna;they had come as far as the vineyards of Timnawhen here, a full-maned roaring lion, [coming] to meet him!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהוָה וַיְשַׁסְּעֵהוּ כְּשַׁסַּע הַגְּדִי וּמְאוּמָה אֵין בְּיָדוֹ וְלֹא הִגִּיד לְאָבִיו וּלְאִמּוֹ אֵת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃
verses.english: YHWH’s spirit advanced upon himand he tore it apart as one tears apart a kid,without a thing in his hand.But he did not tell his father and his mother what he had done.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד וַיְדַבֵּר לָאִשָּׁה וַתִּישַׁר בְּעֵינֵי שִׁמְשׁוֹן׃
verses.english: Then he went down and spoke to the woman—she was right in Shimshon’s eyes.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב מִיָּמִים לְקַחְתָּהּ וַיָּסַר לִרְאוֹת אֵת מַפֶּלֶת הָאַרְיֵה וְהִנֵּה עֲדַת דְּבוֹרִים בִּגְוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה וּדְבָשׁ׃
verses.english: He returned after a year to take her;he turned aside to see the fallen lion,and here: a swarm of bees in the lion’s corpse, and honey which in our story signifies the lion.!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְדֵּהוּ אֶל־כַּפָּיו וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְאָכֹל וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־אָבִיו וְאֶל־אִמּוֹ וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם וַיֹּאכֵלוּ וְלֹא־הִגִּיד לָהֶם כִּי מִגְּוִיַּת הָאַרְיֵה רָדָה הַדְּבָשׁ׃
verses.english: He broke it off here may be for the sake of punning with the theme word y-r-d, “go down” (Boling). into his hands,and went along, going and eating.Then he went back to his father and to his mother,and gave some to them, and they ate.But he did not tell them that it was from the lion’s corpse that he had broken off the honey.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרֶד אָבִיהוּ אֶל־הָאִשָּׁה וַיַּעַשׂ שָׁם שִׁמְשׁוֹן מִשְׁתֶּה כִּי כֵּן יַעֲשׂוּ הַבַּחוּרִים׃
verses.english: His father went down on account of the woman,and Shimshon made a drinkfest there, for that is what young men do;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָם אוֹתוֹ וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁלֹשִׁים מֵרֵעִים וַיִּהְיוּ אִתּוֹ׃
verses.english: and it was when they saw him, that they fetched thirty feasting-companions [who] remained with him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אָחוּדָה־נָּא לָכֶם חִידָה אִם־הַגֵּד תַּגִּידוּ אוֹתָהּ לִי שִׁבְעַת יְמֵי הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וּמְצָאתֶם וְנָתַתִּי לָכֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים חֲלִפֹת בְּגָדִים׃
verses.english: Shimshon said to them:Now let me riddle you a riddle!If you can tell, yes, tell me its [answer] during the seven days of the drinkfestand can find it out,I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes;

verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תוּכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד לִי וּנְתַתֶּם אַתֶּם לִי שְׁלֹשִׁים סְדִינִים וּשְׁלֹשִׁים חֲלִיפוֹת בְּגָדִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ חוּדָה חִידָתְךָ וְנִשְׁמָעֶנָּה׃
verses.english: but if you are not able to tell me,you will have to give me, yourselves, thirty linen garments and thirty changes of clothes.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם מֵהָאֹכֵל יָצָא מַאֲכָל וּמֵעַז יָצָא מָתוֹק וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד הַחִידָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים׃
verses.english: He said to them:Out of the eater came food-to-eat,out of the strong one came something sweet.They could not tell him [the answer to] the riddle for three days;

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְאֵשֶׁת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן פַּתִּי אֶת־אִישֵׁךְ וְיַגֶּד־לָנוּ אֶת־הַחִידָה פֶּן־נִשְׂרֹף אוֹתָךְ וְאֶת־בֵּית אָבִיךְ בָּאֵשׁ הַלְיָרְשֵׁנוּ קְרָאתֶם לָנוּ הֲלֹא׃
verses.english: so on the fourth day it was that they said to Shimshon’s wife:Seduce may also connote “deceive,” taking advantage of his gullible nature. This will happen with another woman in 16:5. your husband, that he may tell us [the answer to] the riddle,lest we burn you and your Father’s House with fire—is it to dispossess us that you have invited us here?

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּבְךְּ אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלָיו וַתֹּאמֶר רַק־שְׂנֵאתַנִי וְלֹא אֲהַבְתָּנִי הַחִידָה חַדְתָּ לִבְנֵי עַמִּי וְלִי לֹא הִגַּדְתָּה וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ הִנֵּה לְאָבִי וּלְאִמִּי לֹא הִגַּדְתִּי וְלָךְ אַגִּיד׃
verses.english: Shimshon’s wife wept on him, she said:You surely hate me, you do not love me;should you riddle a riddle to the sons of my people,and not tell [the answer] to me?He said to her:Here, I haven’t told it to my father or to my mother—so should I tell it to you?

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּבְךְּ עָלָיו שִׁבְעַת הַיָּמִים אֲשֶׁר־הָיָה לָהֶם הַמִּשְׁתֶּה וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ כִּי הֱצִיקַתְהוּ וַתַּגֵּד הַחִידָה לִבְנֵי עַמָּהּ׃
verses.english: She wept on him for the seven days in which they held the drinkfest,and then it was, on the seventh day, that he told it to her, for she kept pressing him,and she told the riddle’s [answer] to the sons of her people.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַחַרְסָה מַה־מָּתוֹק מִדְּבַשׁ וּמֶה עַז מֵאֲרִי וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לוּלֵא חֲרַשְׁתֶּם בְּעֶגְלָתִי לֹא מְצָאתֶם חִידָתִי׃
verses.english: So the men of the city said to him on the seventh day, before the daystar set to heder, “inner-room,” suggesting that the marriage is about to be consummated. :What is sweeter than honey?What is stronger than a lion?He said to them:If with my heifer you’d not plowed the ground,my riddle’s answer you’d never have found! [heifer…riddle].

verses.hebrew: וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהוָה וַיֵּרֶד אַשְׁקְלוֹן וַיַּךְ מֵהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים אִישׁ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־חֲלִיצוֹתָם וַיִּתֵּן הַחֲלִיפוֹת לְמַגִּידֵי הַחִידָה וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ וַיַּעַל בֵּית אָבִיהוּ׃
verses.english: And YHWH’s spirit advanced upon him;he went down to Ashkelonand struck down thirty fighting-men of them,took their sashesand gave them as clothing-changes. to those who had told the riddle’s [answer].His anger flared on,and he went up to his father’s house.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּהִי אֵשֶׁת שִׁמְשׁוֹן לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ אֲשֶׁר רֵעָה לוֹ׃
verses.english: Now Shimshon’s wife was [given] to one of his feasting-companions, who had been his [own] companion.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִיָּמִים בִּימֵי קְצִיר־חִטִּים וַיִּפְקֹד שִׁמְשׁוֹן אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ בִּגְדִי עִזִּים וַיֹּאמֶר אָבֹאָה אֶל־אִשְׁתִּי הֶחָדְרָה וְלֹא־נְתָנוֹ אָבִיהָ לָבוֹא׃
verses.english: Now it was [after] a year, in the days of the wheat cutting,that Shimshon visited his wife with a goats’ kid;he said: I will come in to my wife, in the inner-room!But her father did not give him [leave] to come in.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָבִיהָ אָמֹר אָמַרְתִּי כִּי־שָׂנֹא שְׂנֵאתָהּ וָאֶתְּנֶנָּה לְמֵרֵעֶךָ הֲלֹא אֲחֹתָהּ הַקְּטַנָּה טוֹבָה מִמֶּנָּה תְּהִי־נָא לְךָ תַּחְתֶּיהָ׃
verses.english: Her father said:I said [to myself], said:Indeed, you bear hatred, yes, hatred toward her,so I gave her to your companion.Isn’t her sister more good-looking than she?Let her be yours in her place!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן נִקֵּיתִי הַפַּעַם מִפְּלִשְׁתִּים כִּי־עֹשֶׂה אֲנִי עִמָּם רָעָה׃
verses.english: Shimshon said to them:This time I will be clear of blame from the Philistines,if I do evil with them!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּלְכֹּד שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת שׁוּעָלִים וַיִּקַּח לַפִּדִים וַיֶּפֶן זָנָב אֶל־זָנָב וַיָּשֶׂם לַפִּיד אֶחָד בֵּין־שְׁנֵי הַזְּנָבוֹת בַּתָּוֶךְ׃
verses.english: So Shimshon wentand captured three hundred foxes,and took [some] torchesand faced tail to tail,and placed each torch between two tails, in the middle,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּבְעֶר־אֵשׁ בַּלַּפִּידִים וַיְשַׁלַּח בְּקָמוֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּבְעֵר מִגָּדִישׁ וְעַד־קָמָה וְעַד־כֶּרֶם זָיִת׃
verses.english: and ignited fire in the torches,and sent them free in the standing-stalks of the Philistines;he ignited from sheaf-stacks to standing-stalks, to vineyards [and] olive-trees.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים מִי עָשָׂה זֹאת וַיֹּאמְרוּ שִׁמְשׁוֹן חֲתַן הַתִּמְנִי כִּי לָקַח אֶת־אִשְׁתּוֹ וַיִּתְּנָהּ לְמֵרֵעֵהוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיִּשְׂרְפוּ אוֹתָהּ וְאֶת־אָבִיהָ בָּאֵשׁ׃
verses.english: The Philistines said:Who has done this?They said:Shimshon, the Timnite’s son-in-law,for he took away his wife and gave her to his companion!So the Philistines went up and burned her and her father with fire.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם־תַּעֲשׂוּן כָּזֹאת כִּי אִם־נִקַּמְתִּי בָכֶם וְאַחַר אֶחְדָּל׃
verses.english: Shimshon said to them:If you do [things] like this,surely when I have avenged myself upon you, [only] afterward will I stop!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּךְ אוֹתָם שׁוֹק עַל־יָרֵךְ מַכָּה גְדוֹלָה וַיֵּרֶד וַיֵּשֶׁב בִּסְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם׃
verses.english: And he struck them down, hip over thigh, a great striking down;then he went down and stayed in the gorge of Etam’s Crag.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּחֲנוּ בִּיהוּדָה וַיִּנָּטְשׁוּ בַּלֶּחִי׃
verses.english: The Philistines went up and camped in Yehuda;they were spread out at Lehi somewhere in the Judean lowlands..

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ יְהוּדָה לָמָה עֲלִיתֶם עָלֵינוּ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֶאֱסוֹר אֶת־שִׁמְשׁוֹן עָלִינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת לוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לָנוּ׃
verses.english: And the fighting-men of Yehuda said:Why have you come up against us?They said:To bind Shimshon have we come up,to do to him as he did to us!

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרְדוּ שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים אִישׁ מִיהוּדָה אֶל־סְעִיף סֶלַע עֵיטָם וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשִׁמְשׁוֹן הֲלֹא יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־מֹשְׁלִים בָּנוּ פְּלִשְׁתִּים וּמַה־זֹּאת עָשִׂיתָ לָּנוּ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ לִי כֵּן עָשִׂיתִי לָהֶם׃
verses.english: Three thousand fighting-men from Yehuda went down to the gorge of Etam’s Cragand said to Shimshon:Don’t you know that the Philistines are ruling us?Now what have you done to us?He said to them:As they did to me, so I did to them!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֶאֱסָרְךָ יָרַדְנוּ לְתִתְּךָ בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם שִׁמְשׁוֹן הִשָּׁבְעוּ לִי פֶּן־תִּפְגְּעוּן בִּי אַתֶּם׃
verses.english: They said to him:We have come down to bind you, to give you into the hand of the Philistines.Shimshon said to them:Swear to me, lest you attack me yourselves!

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ לֵאמֹר לֹא כִּי־אָסֹר נֶאֱסָרְךָ וּנְתַנּוּךָ בְיָדָם וְהָמֵת לֹא נְמִיתֶךָ וַיַּאַסְרֻהוּ בִּשְׁנַיִם עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַיַּעֲלוּהוּ מִן־הַסָּלַע׃
verses.english: They said to him, saying:No,rather, we want to bind, yes, bind you, and give you into their hand,but death, we will not cause your death!So they bound him with two new ropesand led him up from the Rock.

verses.hebrew: הוּא־בָא עַד־לֶחִי וּפְלִשִׁתִּים הֵרִיעוּ לִקְרָאתוֹ וַתִּצְלַח עָלָיו רוּחַ יְהוָה וַתִּהְיֶינָה הָעֲבֹתִים אֲשֶׁר עַל־זְרוֹעוֹתָיו כַּפִּשְׁתִּים אֲשֶׁר בָּעֲרוּ בָאֵשׁ וַיִּמַּסּוּ אֱסוּרָיו מֵעַל יָדָיו׃
verses.english: He had come as far as Lehi,when the Philistines shouted [in triumph] meeting him;YHWH’s spirit advanced upon him,and the ropes which were on his arms becamelike [threads of] flax which are ignited with fire;his bonds melted off his hands.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא לְחִי־חֲמוֹר טְרִיָּה וַיִּשְׁלַח יָדוֹ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיַּךְ־בָּהּ אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃
verses.english: He found the fresh jawbone of a donkeyand stretched out his hand and took it,and with it he struck down a thousand men.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שִׁמְשׁוֹן בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר חֲמוֹר חֲמֹרָתָיִם בִּלְחִי הַחֲמוֹר הִכֵּיתִי אֶלֶף אִישׁ׃
verses.english: Then Shimshon said:With the jawbone of a donkey to mean “heap,” thus: “With the jawbone of an ass, / heaping mass upon mass …” Boling (1975) likens the phrase hamor hamortayim to raham rahamatayim (“a lass, two lasses”) and rikma … rikmatayim (“embroidered cloth … embroidered”) in 5:30.,one donkey, two donkeys,with the jawbone of a donkeyI’ve struck down a thousand men!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּכַלֹּתוֹ לְדַבֵּר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ הַלְּחִי מִיָּדוֹ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא רָמַת לֶחִי׃
verses.english: It was, when he had finished speaking,that he threw the jawbone from his hand—so they called that place Ramat Lehi/Jawbone Height may also denote “toss away,” fitting the action in the previous verse..

verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְמָא מְאֹד וַיִּקְרָא אֶל־יְהוָה וַיֹּאמַר אַתָּה נָתַתָּ בְיַד־עַבְדְּךָ אֶת־הַתְּשׁוּעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְעַתָּה אָמוּת בַּצָּמָא וְנָפַלְתִּי בְּיַד הָעֲרֵלִים׃
verses.english: He became exceedingly thirsty, so he called out to YHWH and said:You yourself have given into your servant’s handthis great deliverance,so-now, shall I die of thirstand fall into the hand of the Foreskinned Ones?

verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְקַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הַמַּכְתֵּשׁ אֲשֶׁר־בַּלֶּחִי וַיֵּצְאוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מַיִם וַיֵּשְׁתְּ וַתָּשָׁב רוּחוֹ וַיֶּחִי עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שְׁמָהּ עֵין הַקּוֹרֵא אֲשֶׁר בַּלֶּחִי עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃
verses.english: So God split open the cavity that was at Lehi,and water came out of it, and he drank;his spirit returned, and he revived.Therefore they called its name En Ha-Korei/Spring of the Caller, which is in Lehi,until this day.

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפֹּט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּימֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה׃
verses.english: He led Israel as judge in the days of the Philistines, for twenty years.

verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַזָּתָה וַיַּרְא־שָׁם אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃
verses.english: Shimshon went to Gaza another major Philistine city along the coast.;he saw there a whore woman, and came in to her.

verses.hebrew: לַעַזָּתִים לֵאמֹר בָּא שִׁמְשׁוֹן הֵנָּה וַיָּסֹבּוּ וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ־לוֹ כָל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּשַׁעַר הָעִיר וַיִּתְחָרְשׁוּ כָל־הַלַּיְלָה לֵאמֹר עַד־אוֹר הַבֹּקֶר וַהֲרְגְנֻהוּ׃
verses.english: Among the Gazites it was said:Shimshon has come here!They circled about and set an ambush for him the whole night at the town gate,and they plotted the whole night, saying:Until the light of daybreak—then we will kill him!

verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּב שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַד־חֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיָּקָם בַּחֲצִי הַלַּיְלָה וַיֶּאֱחֹז בְּדַלְתוֹת שַׁעַר־הָעִיר וּבִשְׁתֵּי הַמְּזוּזוֹת וַיִּסָּעֵם עִם־הַבְּרִיחַ וַיָּשֶׂם עַל־כְּתֵפָיו וַיַּעֲלֵם אֶל־רֹאשׁ הָהָר אֲשֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵי חֶבְרוֹן׃
verses.english: Shimshon lay until the middle of the night;he arose in the middle of the nightand seized the doors of the town gate, along with the two posts,and pulled them up, together with the boltand put them on his shouldersand brought them up to the top of the hill that faces Hevron.

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחֲרֵי־כֵן וַיֶּאֱהַב אִשָּׁה בְּנַחַל שֹׂרֵק וּשְׁמָהּ דְּלִילָה׃
verses.english: Now it was [some time] after thisthat he fell in love with a woman in the Wadi of Sorek/Vines;her name was Delila trad. English “Delilah.” Many meanings have been theorized for the name, including “vine” (alluding to Shimshon’s violation of his vows), “flirt” (Arabic), and “dangling curls” (Niditch 2008; the hair motif again). Most significant, in my view, is the name’s resemblance to Heb. layla, “night,” evocative of seduction and a fitting contrast to Shimshon’s name’s connection to “sun.”.

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ אֵלֶיהָ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהּ פַּתִּי אוֹתוֹ וּרְאִי בַּמֶּה כֹּחוֹ גָדוֹל וּבַמֶּה נוּכַל לוֹ וַאֲסַרְנֻהוּ לְעַנֹּתוֹ וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִתַּן־לָךְ אִישׁ אֶלֶף וּמֵאָה כָּסֶף׃
verses.english: The Philistine overlords went up to her and said to her:Seduce him and seewhereby his might is so great,whereby we can overcome him,so that we can bind him, to subdue him,and we ourselves, each one, will give you a thousand and a hundred pieces of silver!

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי בַּמֶּה כֹּחֲךָ גָדוֹל וּבַמֶּה תֵאָסֵר לְעַנּוֹתֶךָ׃
verses.english: Delila said to Shimshon:Pray tell me,whereby is your might so great,whereby can you be bound, to subdue you?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן אִם־יַאַסְרֻנִי בְּשִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חֹרָבוּ וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי כְּאַחַד הָאָדָם׃
verses.english: Shimshon said to her:If they were to bind me with seven fresh gut-strings, that have not been dried,I’d become weak, I’d become like, which feels like a deliberate rhyme. It recurs twice here, and suggests the rhythm of a folktale. The usual translation is “I will become as weak as any other man,” but that misses the style.any man!

verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ־לָהּ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים שִׁבְעָה יְתָרִים לַחִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־חֹרָבוּ וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָּהֶם׃
verses.english: The Philistine overlords brought up to her seven fresh gut-strings, that had not been dried,and she bound him with them.

verses.hebrew: וְהָאֹרֵב יֹשֵׁב לָהּ בַּחֶדֶר וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיְנַתֵּק אֶת־הַיְתָרִים כַּאֲשֶׁר יִנָּתֵק פְּתִיל־הַנְּעֹרֶת בַּהֲרִיחוֹ אֵשׁ וְלֹא נוֹדַע כֹּחוֹ׃
verses.english: Now the ambush was sitting for her in the inner-room.She said to him:Philistines upon you, Shimshon!He snapped the stringsas hempen cord bursts when it smells fire,and his might was not made known.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן הִנֵּה הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלַי כְּזָבִים עַתָּה הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי בַּמֶּה תֵּאָסֵר׃
verses.english: Delila said to Shimshon:Here, you’ve taunted me,you’ve been speaking lies to me—but now, pray tell me:whereby can you be bound?

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אִם־אָסוֹר יַאַסְרוּנִי בַּעֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נַעֲשָׂה בָהֶם מְלָאכָה וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי כְּאַחַד הָאָדָם׃
verses.english: He said to her:If they were to bind, yes, bind me with new ropes,with which no work has been done,I’d become weak, I’d become likeany man!

verses.hebrew: וַתִּקַּח דְּלִילָה עֲבֹתִים חֲדָשִׁים וַתַּאַסְרֵהוּ בָהֶם וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וְהָאֹרֵב יֹשֵׁב בֶּחָדֶר וַיְנַתְּקֵם מֵעַל זְרֹעֹתָיו כַּחוּט׃
verses.english: So Delila took new ropesand bound him with them,and said to him:Philistines upon you, Shimshon!—Now the ambush was sitting in the inner-room.—He snapped them from off his arms like a thread.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר דְּלִילָה אֶל־שִׁמְשׁוֹן עַד־הֵנָּה הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלַי כְּזָבִים הַגִּידָה לִּי בַּמֶּה תֵּאָסֵר וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלֶיהָ אִם־תַּאַרְגִי אֶת־שֶׁבַע מַחְלְפוֹת רֹאשִׁי עִם־הַמַּסָּכֶת׃
verses.english: Delila said to Shimshon:Until now you’ve taunted me,you’ve been speaking lies to me—tell me:whereby can you be bound?He said to her:If you were to weave the seven locks of my head in a warp …

verses.hebrew: וַתִּתְקַע בַּיָּתֵד וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּיקַץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיִּסַּע אֶת־הַיְתַד הָאֶרֶג וְאֶת־הַמַּסָּכֶת׃
verses.english: She drove them tight with the pin,and said to him:Philistines upon you, Shimshon!He awoke from his sleepand pulled out the pin) was used to describe Shimshon’s “pulling up” the gates of Gaza in v.3, above., the weaver’s-bobbin, and the warp.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֵיךְ תֹּאמַר אֲהַבְתִּיךְ וְלִבְּךָ אֵין אִתִּי זֶה שָׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִים הֵתַלְתָּ בִּי וְלֹא־הִגַּדְתָּ לִּי בַּמֶּה כֹּחֲךָ גָדוֹל׃
verses.english: Then she said to him:How can you say: I love you,when your heart is not with me?Three times now you’ve taunted me,yet you haven’t told mewhereby your might is so great!

verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּי־הֵצִיקָה לּוֹ בִדְבָרֶיהָ כָּל־הַיָּמִים וַתְּאַלֲצֵהוּ וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ לָמוּת׃
verses.english: And it was,when she had pressed him with her words all the timeand had prodded him, so that he became short-tempered to [the point of] death,

verses.hebrew: וַיַּגֶּד־לָהּ אֶת־כָּל־לִבּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר לָהּ מוֹרָה לֹא־עָלָה עַל־רֹאשִׁי כִּי־נְזִיר אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אִם־גֻּלַּחְתִּי וְסָר מִמֶּנִּי כֹחִי וְחָלִיתִי וְהָיִיתִי כְּכָל־הָאָדָם׃
verses.english: that he told her all his heart;he said to her:No razor has gone up on my head,for One Consecrated to God have I been from my mother’s womb on:if I were to be shaven,my might would leave me;I’d become weak, I’d become like all men! to ke-ahad) as in the previous occurrences of the phrase. But the slight shift in wording here may give Delila a hint that Shimshon has cracked at last (see the double “all his heart” in the next verse).

verses.hebrew: וַתֵּרֶא דְלִילָה כִּי־הִגִּיד לָהּ אֶת־כָּל־לִבּוֹ וַתִּשְׁלַח וַתִּקְרָא לְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים לֵאמֹר עֲלוּ הַפַּעַם כִּי־הִגִּיד לה [לִי] אֶת־כָּל־לִבּוֹ וְעָלוּ אֵלֶיהָ סַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיַּעֲלוּ הַכֶּסֶף בְּיָדָם׃
verses.english: Delila saw that he had told her all his heart,so she sent and called for the Philistine overlords, saying:Come up this time,for he has told me all his heart!The Philistine overlords went up to her,and they brought up the silver in their hand.

verses.hebrew: וַתְּיַשְּׁנֵהוּ עַל־בִּרְכֶּיהָ וַתִּקְרָא לָאִישׁ וַתְּגַלַּח אֶת־שֶׁבַע מַחְלְפוֹת רֹאשׁוֹ וַתָּחֶל לְעַנּוֹתוֹ וַיָּסַר כֹּחוֹ מֵעָלָיו׃
verses.english: She lulled him to sleep upon her knees,and she called for a man and he shaved off the seven locks of his head;she began to subdue him,and his might left him.

verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאמֶר פְּלִשְׁתִּים עָלֶיךָ שִׁמְשׁוֹן וַיִּקַץ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֵצֵא כְּפַעַם בְּפַעַם וְאִנָּעֵר וְהוּא לֹא יָדַע כִּי יְהוָה סָר מֵעָלָיו׃
verses.english: Then she said:Philistines upon you, Shimshon!He awoke from his sleep,and he said [to himself]:I’ll get away as time after time,I’ll shake myself free!But he did not know that YHWH had left him.

verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאחֲזוּהוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים וַיְנַקְּרוּ אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיּוֹרִידוּ אוֹתוֹ עַזָּתָה וַיַּאַסְרוּהוּ בַּנְחֻשְׁתַּיִם וַיְהִי טוֹחֵן בְּבֵית האסירים [הָאֲסוּרִים׃]
verses.english: The Philistines grabbed him and gouged out his eyes;then they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with double­bronze,and he had to grind [grain] in the prison house.

verses.hebrew: וַיָּחֶל שְׂעַר־רֹאשׁוֹ לְצַמֵּחַ כַּאֲשֶׁר גֻּלָּח׃
verses.english: But the hair of his head began to sprout again, as soon as it had been shaven off.

verses.hebrew: וְסַרְנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֱסְפוּ לִזְבֹּחַ זֶבַח־גָּדוֹל לְדָגוֹן אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וּלְשִׂמְחָה וַיֹּאמְרוּ נָתַן אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּיָדֵנוּ אֵת שִׁמְשׁוֹן אוֹיְבֵינוּ׃
verses.english: Now the Philistine overlords gathered together to sacrifice a great sacrifice to Dagon a Semitic fertility god, the worship of whom was adopted by the Philistines. See I Sam. 5 for a further story regarding the god’s statue. their godand for [a feast of] rejoicing.They said:Given has our godinto our handShimshon our foe!
